text.body: śrīrastu | suvarṇasaptatiśāstram‌ | pūrvakhaṇḍaḥ | duḥkhatrayābhighātājjijñāsā tadabhighātake hetau | dṛṣṭe sāpārthā cennaikāntātyantato'bhāvāt‌ || 1 || asyā āryāyā upodghāta ucyate | purā kila maharṣirākāśajātaḥ (brahmasutaḥ ?) svābhāvikadharmajñānavairāgyaiśvaryacaturguṇātmakaḥ kapilo nāma babhūva | andhatamasi majjajjagadidamavalokya [asya] mahākāruṇyamudapādi aho khalu jagad‌ [idam‌] andhe tamasi vartata iti | [evaṃ] lokaṃ vicintayan‌ ekaṃ brāhmaṇamāsurisagotraṃ varṣasahasrayājinamadrākṣīt‌ | nigūḍhātmā tamupetya vācamevamuvāca bho āsure ramase gṛhasthadharmeṇa iti | imāṃ vācamuktvā anantaḥ pratijagāma | bhūyo'pi varṣasahasre pūrṇe pratyāgamya tathaivābhyuvāca | evamukte brāhmaṇo muniṃ pratyuvāca satyaṃ bhagavan‌ rame gṛhasthadharmeṇa iti | tadā maharṣiḥ śrutvaitat‌ punarniragāt‌ | sa paścādbhūya abhyupetya [tāmeva] vācamabhyuvāca | brāhmaṇastaṃ pratyāha evameveti | maharṣistu apṛcchat‌ | utsahase śuddhaṃ brahmacaryaṃ vastuṃ na vā iti | brāhmaṇa āha utsahe tathā vastumiti | atha gṛhasthadharmamapahāya pravrajyācaryāmācaran‌ kapilaśiṣyo babhūva | para āha | kasmāddhetorasya brāhmaṇasya jijñāsā samutpannā | uttaramāha | trividhaduḥkhābhighātāt‌ | kiṃ punastrividhaṃ duḥkham‌ | ādhyātmikam‌ ādhibhautikam‌ ādhidaivikam‌ | [tatra] ādhyātmikaṃ yad‌ vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ vaiṣamyāt‌ pravartate vyādhiduḥkham‌ | yathoktaṃ cikitsā[tantre] | "nābheradho vātasthānamucyate | hṛdayādadhaḥ pittasthānamucyate | hṛdayādūrdhvaṃ sarvaṃ śleṣmasambandhi | vātamutkaṭaṃ sat‌ śleṣmapitte abhibhūya vātarogamutpādayati | pittaśleṣmaṇī apyevam‌ ||" idamucyate śārīraṃ duḥkham‌ | mānasaṃ duḥkhaṃ priyaviprayogaḥ apriyasaṃyogaḥ prārthitālābhaḥ etattrividhaṃ mānasaṃ duḥkham‌ | īdṛśaṃ duḥkhamādhyātmikaṃ duḥkhamabhidhīyate | ādhibhautikaṃ tu yanmartyapaśupakṣyuragataṭasetubhedādinā pravartate duḥkham‌ | [ida]mādhibhautikaṃ duḥkhamucyate | ādhidaivikaṃ yat‌ śītātapavātavarṣāśanyādirnānāvidho marmabhedī | [ida]mādhidaivikaṃ duḥkhamabhidhīyate | [etaiḥ] tribhirduḥkhairabhighātāt‌ [1245, c. 2] samutpannā jijñāsā duḥkhābhighātake hetau | para āha | etadduḥkhatrayābhighātako [dvividho]'yaṃ hetuḥ vispaṣṭaṃ pratyakṣaḥ | prathamaḥ, aṣṭāṅgāyurvedoktaḥ, śārīraduḥkhasyābhighātakaḥ | dvitīyaḥ, priyāḥ ṣaḍ‌ viṣayā mānasaduḥkhasyābhighātakāḥ | imau hetū pratyakṣāveva | kathaṃ punarjijñāsā | samādhīyate | nāyamartho yujyate | dvividhadoṣasattvāt‌ | jijñāsā na yuktiviruddhā | sa dvividho doṣaśca [hetoḥ] anaikāntikatā anātyantikatā ceti || 1 || para āha | yadi aṣṭāṅgāyurvedādikaṃ doṣadvayayuktatvān na heturalaṃ duḥkhābhighātāya | caturṣu vedeṣu tu hetvantaramasti | ayaṃ heturaikāntikamātyantikañca phalaṃ prāpayati | ato bhavato jijñāsā apārthā | uktaṃ hi vede | apāma somamamṛtā abhūmāganma jyotiravidāma devān‌ | kiṃ nūnamasmān‌ kṛṇavadarātiḥ kimu dhūrtiramṛta martyasya || iti | uttaramāha | dṛṣṭavadānuśravikaḥ sa hyaviśuddhikṣayātiśayayuktaḥ | tadviparītaḥ śreyān‌ vyaktāvyaktajñavijñānāt‌ || 2 || dṛṣṭo heturāyurvedoktaḥ anaikāntikānātyantika[rūpa]doṣayuktaḥ | ānuśraviko hetuḥ upadeśaśravaṇalabdhaḥ brahmaṇa ārabhya [kapila]maharṣiparyantam‌ | ataścatvāro vedā ānuśravikā ucyante | ime vedā api dvidhā duṣṭāḥ yathā āyurvedo dṛṣṭaḥ | kiñca punardoṣatrayayuktaḥ | aviśuddhiḥ | yathoktaṃ vede he paśo tava pitā mātā bandhavaḥ sarve'pi tvāmanumanyatām‌ | idaṃ śarīraṃ tyaktvā divi janma lapsyase || iti | yathoktamaśvamedhe | ṣaṭ‍ śatāni nihanyante paśūnām‌ | ṣaṭśatapaśavasatribhirūnāḥ | [yadi tato'pi] ūnāḥ, tadā na divi janma prāpayanti ānandādipañcavṛttyartham‌ | yadyanṛtaṃ brūyānmanuṣyaḥ, deā maharṣayaścāhurnaitatpāpamiti | evamādipāpamānuśravike hetāvasti | tasmādaviśuddhaḥ | kṣayaḥ | yathoktaṃ vede | kālena samatītāni kālo hi duratikramaḥ || iti | yadāyaṃ dharmaḥ kṣīyate tadā dātā svargānnivartate | ataḥ kṣayayuktaḥ | atiśayaḥ yathā āḍhyamavalokya daridraḥ khidyate | surūpaṃ vīkṣya kurūpaḥ prājñañca dṛṣṭvā mūrkhaḥ khidyate | tathā svarge'pi uttamavargaṃ dṛṣṭvā hīnavargaḥ khidyate | tasmādatiśayayuktaḥ | ete trayaḥ, pūrva[muktau] dvau, tābhyāṃ saha pañca doṣāḥ iti vedo na [duḥkhābhighātāya] hetuḥ | para āha | yathā cetko hetuḥ śreyān‌ | uttaramāha | etadvividhahetuviparītaḥ śreyāniti | yau dvau hetū āyurvedokto vedoktaśca | aikāntikaḥ ātyantikaḥ viśuddhaḥ akṣayaḥ samānaḥ iti | tasmāt‌ pūrvadvayādutkṛṣṭaḥ | para āha | ayaṃ hetuḥ kuto labhyate | uttaramāha | vyaktāvyaktajñavijñānāditi | vyaktam‌, mahānahaṅkāraḥ pañca tanmātrāṇi pañca [karme]ndriyāṇi pañca buddhīndriyāṇi manaḥ pañca mahābhūtāni ca | etāni sapta vyaktamityākhyāyante | prakṛtikṛtatvāt‌ | avyaktaṃ pradhānaṃ mūlakāraṇam‌ | jñaḥ puruṣaḥ | etatpañcaviṃśatitattvaprameyajñānāṃ na vṛddhiḥ na kṣayaḥ duḥkhatrayādaikāntikamokṣaśca bhavati | yathoktā mokṣe gāthā | pañcaviṃśatitattvajño yatra tatrāśrame vaset‌ | jaṭī muṇḍī śikhī vāpi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 2 || iti para āha | kathaṃ mūlaprakṛtivikṛtipuruṣāṇāṃ pravibhāgaḥ | uttaramāha | mūlaprakṛtiravikṛtiḥ mahadādyāḥ prakṛtivikṛtayaḥ sapta | ṣoḍaśakastu vikāro na prakṛtirna vikṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ || 3 || mūlaprakṛtiḥ sarvajananī | anyasmādanutpattermūlaprakṛtiriti vyapadiśyate | mūlaprakṛtirmahadādīnāṃ janakatvānmūleti nāma labhate | avikṛtiḥ anyasmādanutpatteḥ | mahānahaṅkāraḥ pañca tanmātrāṇi, etāni sapta prakṛtayo vikṛtayaśca | mahān‌ mūlaprakṛtita utpanna iti vikṛtiḥ | pañca tanmātrāṇi janayatīti prakṛtiḥ | pañca tanmātrāṇi ahaṅkārādutpannāni iti vikṛtayaḥ | mahābhūtāni indriyāṇi ca utpādayantīti prakṛtayaḥ | [tatra] śabdatanmātramākāśaṃ śrotrendriyañca janayatīti prakṛtiḥ yāvadgandhatanmātraṃ pṛthivīṃ ghrāṇendriyañca janayatīti | evaṃ saptāpi prakṛtayo vikṛtayaśca | ṣoḍaśako vikāra eveti | ākāśādipañcamahābhūtāni śrotrādipañca[buddhī]ndriyāṇi jihvādipañcakarmendriyāṇi manaśca itīme ṣoḍaśa dharmā anyasmādevotpannatvād‌ anyānutpādakatvācca vikāra eva | puruṣo na prakṛtirvikṛtirveti | puruṣo'tra ātmā ucyate | jñānātmakatvāt‌ | sa ātmā notpādako nānyasmādutpannaḥ | pūrvatrayādbhinna iti na prakṛtirna vikṛtiḥ || 3 || para āha | ime [vyaktāvyaktajñāḥ] trayaḥ padārthāḥ kena pramāṇena jñāpyante | loke pramāṇaṃ hi [prameya]jñāpanasamartham‌ | yathā tulāhastādīni dīrghaṃ hrasvaṃ guru laghu vā jñāpayanti | uttaramāha | dṛṣṭamanumānamāptavacanañca sarvapramāṇasiddhatvāt‌ | trividhaṃ pramāṇamiṣṭaṃ prameyasiddhiḥ pramāṇāddhi || 4 || asmin‌ śāstre trividhaṃ pramāṇaṃ sthāpitam‌ | dṛṣṭam‌ anumānam‌ āptavacanañceti | dṛṣṭaṃ pramāṇam‌ indriyaviṣayābhyāmutpannaṃ [yad‌] etajjñānaprakāśitamavyabhicāri asandigdhañca; idamucyate dṛṣṭaṃ pramāṇam‌ | anumānaṃ pramāṇaṃ dṛṣṭapūrvakam‌ | tattrividhaṃ pūrvavat‌ śeṣavat‌ sāmānyato dṛṣṭamiti | yo'yamarthaḥ pratyakṣānumānapramāṇābhyāṃ nādhigamyate | āptavacanena punarayamadhigamyate | yathā svargaḥ uttarāvatī | [ayamarthaḥ] pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ nādhigamyate | āptavacanena punaradhigamyate | āptavacanaṃ yathoktaṃ gāthāyām‌ | āgamo hyāptavacanamāptaṃ doṣakṣayā[dviduḥ] | kṣīṇadoṣo'nṛtaṃ vākyaṃ na brūyāddhetvasambhavāt‌ || iti | sarvaprameyāni jñāpayanti iti | yadavaśiṣṭaṃ pramāṇamavaśiṣṭaṃ prameyañca; [etatsarvam‌] asmāt‌ trividhāt‌ pramānānna bahirbhavati | upamānādi ṣaṭpramāṇānāmāptavacane'ntarbhāvāt‌ | prameyasiddhiḥ pramāṇāddhīti | prameyaiḥ pañcaviṃśatipadārthaiḥ sarvasaṅgrahāt‌ | siddhiḥ etatpañcaviṃśati[padārtha]vittiḥ | kathaṃ te prameyamiti nāma labhante | pramāṇasya gocaratvāt‌, prameyamiti siddhyati | pratyakṣānumānāptavacanaiḥ saṃkṣepeṇa siddhāstrayaḥ [vyaktāvyaktajñāḥ padārthāḥ] pañcaviṃśatidhā tu vistṛtāḥ || 4 || para āha | uktāni trividhapramāṇāni | kiṃ pramāṇalakṣaṇam‌ | uttaramāha | prativiṣayādhyavasāyo dṛṣṭaṃ trividhamanumānamākhyātam‌ | talliṅgaliṅgipūrvakamāptaśrutirāptavacanantu || 5 || prativiṣayādhyavasāyo dṛṣṭamiti | śrotraṃ śabde'dhyavasāyaṃ janayati | yāvad‌ ghrāṇaṃ gandhe'dhyavasāyaḥ janayati | adhyavasāyakameva, na tu jñāpakam‌; idamucyate dṛṣṭaṃ pramāṇam‌ | anumānaṃ trividhaṃ jñātamiti | pūrvavat‌ śeṣavat‌ sāmānyato dṛṣṭamiti | etattrividhaṃ jñānaṃ dṛṣṭapramāṇahetukamiti trividhasya prameyasya trividhasyādhvanaśca vibhedanakṣamam‌, idamanumānamucyate | yathā kaścit‌ kṛṣṇameghaṃ dṛṣṭvā jānīyād‌ vṛṣṭiravaśyaṃ [bhaviṣyati] iti | yathā nadyāṃ pūrṇaṃ nūtanaṃ paṅkilaṃ jalaṃ dṛṣṭvā jānīyādavaśyamupari vṛṣṭirabhūditi | yathā vā pāṭalipure āmrataruṃ puṣpitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kośaladeśe'pyevamiti jānīyāt‌ | liṅgaliṅgipūrvakamiti | liṅgaṃ liṅginā saṃyuktaṃ na viyuktam‌ | liṅgadarśanādanumitiḥ sādhyate | āptaśrutirāptavacanamucyate iti | yathā brahmaṇā manunā ca uktāścatvāro vedā dharmaśāstrañca || 5 || para āha | trividhamanumānamuktam‌ | [tatra] kena pramāṇena kasya prameyasya siddhirbudhyate | uttaramāha | sāmānyatastu dṛṣṭādatīndriyāṇāṃ pratītiranumānāt‌ | tasmādapi cāsiddhaṃ parokṣamāptāgamātsiddham‌ || 6 || sāmānyato dṛṣṭeti | yadidamanumānapramāṇe sāmānyato dṛṣṭaṃ pramāṇamuktam‌ | [yau] prakṛtipuruṣau, imau viṣayāvatīndriyatvātsāmānyato dṛṣṭaṃ pramāṇaṃ sādhayati | mahadādikāryāṇi sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ mohaśceti triguṇayuktāni | ime kāryaguṇāḥ | vinā pradhānaguṇān‌ kāryaguṇā na siddhyanti | ataḥ kāryaguṇena pradhānamanumīyate | tasmātprakṛtiḥ sāmānyato dṛṣṭānumānena siddhā | puruṣeṇa ekāntato vartitavyam‌ | mahadādivikārāṇāṃ parārthatvāt‌ | ataḥ puruṣo'pi sāmānyato dṛṣṭānumānena siddhaḥ | yadi dṛṣṭānumānābhyāṃ kaścidartho'siddhaḥ | tadā [taduttha]jñānabahirbhūtatvād‌ āptavacanenādhyavasīyate | yathā śakro devendra uttarāvatī [?] ityādi || 6 || para āha | prakṛtipuruṣau na staḥ | adṛṣṭatvāt‌ | yathā anīśvarasya dve śirasī trayo bāhavaḥ | samādhīyate | vastutaḥ satāmarthānāmaṣṭavidhā anupalabdhayaḥ | kā aṣṭavidhāḥ | āryayā pradarśayati | atidūrātsāmīpyādindriyaghātānmano'navasthānāt‌ | saukṣmyādvyavadhānādabhibhavātsamānābhihārācca || 7 || loke vastutaḥ satāṃ vastunāmatidūrādanupalabdhiḥ | yathā tīrāntarapatitānāmanupalabdhiḥ | sāmīpyādanupalabdhiḥ | yathā akṣigatasya vastuna agrahaḥ | indriyaghātādanupalabdhiḥ | yathā badhirāndhau śabdarūpe nopalabhete | mano'navasthānādanupalabdhiḥ | yathā anyālambanacittaḥ [purovartinaṃ] viṣayaṃ nopalabhate | saukṣmyādanupalabdhiḥ | yatha dhūmoṣmatruṭinīhāra[paramāṇavaḥ] gaganagatāḥ sūkṣmā nopalabhyante | vyavadhānādanupalabdhiḥ | yathā kuḍyena vyavahitaṃ vastu nopalabhyate | abhibhavādanupalabdhiḥ | yathā sūryodgame nakṣatraṃ candraśca na prakāśate | samānābhihārādanupalabdhiḥ | yathā māṣarāśigataṃ māṣadhānyaṃ samajātīyaṃ, durjñānam‌ | evamaṣṭadhā satāṃ vastunāmanupalabdhiḥ | asatāmapi vastunāṃ caturdhā anupalabdhiḥ | prāgabhāvādanupalabdhiḥ | yathā mṛdā bhājanaṃ [yadā] na kṛtam‌, tadā bhājanaṃ nopalabhyate | pradhvaṃsābhāvādanupalabdhiḥ | yathā ghaṭo dhvasto na punarupalabhyate | itaretarābhāvādanupalabdhiḥ | yathā gavi aśva[tvaṃ] na dṛśyate, aśve go[tvaṃ] na dṛśyate | atyantābhāvādanupalabdhiḥ | yathā anīśvarasya dve śirasī trayo bāhavaḥ | evaṃ dvādaśavidhāḥ satāmasatāñcānupalabdhayaḥ | tasmād‌ yaduktaṃ bhavatā prakṛtipuruṣau na staḥ, anupalabdhatvād‌ iti | etanna yujyate || 7 || para āha | yadi prakṛtipuruṣau nopalabhyeta | dvādaśānāṃ madhye kena nopalabhyete | samādhīyate | ekasmātkāraṇānnopalabhyete | kimekaṃ kāraṇam‌ | āryayā pradarśayati | saukṣmyāttadanupalabdhirnābhāvātkāryatastadupalabdhiḥ | mahadādi tacca kāryaṃ prakṛtivirūpaṃ sarūpañca || 8 || prakṛtiḥ saukṣmyānnopalabhyate, na kāraṇamupalabdhamasaditi | iti | pradhānaṃ sadeva nopalabhyate | saukṣmyād‌ yathā dhūmādi[paramāṇavaḥ] saukṣmyānnopalabhyante | tathā pradhānamapi | na tu dvitīyaṃ śiraḥ tṛtīyo bāhurivātyantamasattvānnopalabhyate | para āha | yadi nopalabhyate | kathaṃ tarhi jñāyate astīti | ucyate | kāryaṃ pratītya svakāraṇaṃ dṛśyate | kāryaṃ pradhānakṛtamiti sāmānyato dṛṣṭānumānātpradhānamastīti jñāyate | para āha | kiṃ tatkāryam‌ | ucyate | mahadādi tasya kāryam‌ | pradhānānmahānutpadyate | mahata ahaṅkāraḥ | ahaṅkārātpañcatanmātrāṇi | pañcatanmātrebhyaḥ ṣoḍaśa [vikārā] utpadyante | mahadādi kāryaṃ triguṇaṃ dṛśyate | ataḥ pradhānaṃ triguṇamiti jñāyate | prakṛtivirūpaṃ sarūpañceti | kāryaṃ dvividhaṃ prakṛtivirūpaṃ prakṛtisarūpañceti | yathā ekasya dvau sutāvutpannau | ekaḥ pitṛsarūpaḥ aparastu [pitṛ]virūpaḥ | [evaṃ] etatkāraṇakaṃ kāryaṃ prakṛtisarūpaṃ virūpañca | iti paścādvistareṇa vakṣyate | īdṛśaṃ kāryamasmin‌ śāstre || 8 || atra pṛcchāmaḥ | yadi śiṣyā niyojyāḥ, kiṃ pradhānādau [kāryaṃ] sat‌, utāsat‌ āhosvit‌ saccāsacca | kathamevam‌ | ācāryāṇāṃ pratipattivaiṣamyāt‌ | kecidācāryā vadanti mṛtpiṇḍādau ghaṭādi kāryamasti | iti | vaiśeṣikā vadanti kāryaṃ prāgasat‌ paścāt‌ saṃbhavati | iti | śākyaiḥ punaruktaṃ mṛtpiṇḍe ghaṭo naivāsti na ca nāsti | iti | ebhistribhi[stredhā] uktatvāt‌ | samādhīyate | prathamaṃ śākyamataṃ khaṇḍayāmaḥ | paścādvaiśeṣika[mataṃ] khaṇḍayāmaḥ | yadāhuḥ śākyāḥ na san‌ na cāsanniti | tanna yujyate | svabhāvato virodhāt‌ | yadi na sanniti | tadā siddho'sanniti | yadi na cāsan‌ iti | tadā siddhaḥ sanniti | ayaṃ saṃścāsaṃśceti na siddhyati | ekatra mitho virodhāt‌ | yathāha kaścit‌, ayaṃ puruṣo mṛto jīvati ceti | etadvacanaṃ mitho viruddhamiti na sādhīyaḥ | śākyavacanamapyevam‌ ‌| (tripiṭaka uktam‌ | ayaṃ kalpo na yuktaḥ | kutaḥ | śākyānāmetadvādāsaṃbhavāt‌ | yadā te vadanti na sanniti | [tadā] nāsadvādaḥ | [yadā] vadanti na cāsanniti | [tadā] na sadvādaḥ | sadasadvādamuktatvāt khaṇḍanaṃ na siddham‌ |) adhunā vaiśeṣikamataṃ khaṇḍayāmaḥ | vaiśeṣikā bhrāntāḥ | asmanmate tu kāraṇe kāryaṃ niyatamiti pañcakāraṇāni pradarśayati | kāni pañcakāraṇāni | asadakaraṇādupādānagrahaṇātsarvasaṃbhavābhāvāt‌ | śaktasya śakyagrahaṇāt‌ kāraṇabhāvācca satkāryam‌ || 9 || asadakaraṇāditi | loke hi asataḥ karaṇaṃ na siddhyati | yathā sikatābhyastailam‌ | sataḥ karaṇaṃ śakyate | yathā tilapīḍanena tailodgamaḥ | yadi kāryamatra nāsti | tato nodbhavet‌ | paśyāmaḥ khalu mahadādi pradhānājjātam‌ | ato jñāyate pradhāne mahadādyastīti | avaśyamupādānagrahaṇāditi | kṛṣṇatantubhyaḥ kṛṣṇapaṭaḥ | kāryakāraṇayoḥ sarūpatvād‍ vyaktaṃ triguṇaṃ jñāyate | vyaktasya ca pradhānakṛtatvāt‌ pradhānaṃ triguṇam‌ iti vyaktāvyaktayoḥ sārūpyamuktam‌ | avivekīti | vyaktaṃ guṇā iti vivektuṃ na pāryate | yathā gauraśvaśvānekātmakau | na tathā guṇā vyaktañca | pradhānaṃ trituṇamapyevaṃ samānamaviveki iti vyaktamavyaktañca sarūpam‌ | viṣaya ita i| mahadādi vyaktaṃ puruṣasyopabhogyatvād‌ viṣaya ityucyate | pradhānamapi tathā | puruṣasyopabhogyatvāt‌ | sāmānyamiti | mahadādi vyaktaṃ sarvapuruṣāṇāṃ sādhāraṇopayogi | yathā ekasyā dāsyā bahavaḥ prabhavaḥ santi | [sarveṣāṃ] sādhāraṇyena niyojyatvāt‌ | tathā pradhānamapi sarvapuruṣāṇāṃ sādhāraṇopayogi | tasmāduktaṃ sarūpamiti | acetanamiti | mahadādi vyaktaṃ sukhaduḥkhamohabhedānna vijānāti | jñānasya puruṣamātralabdhatvāt‌ | puruṣavyatiriktā dharmā acetanāḥ | tathā pradhānamapi | vyaktamavyaktañca samamacetanam‌ | tayorbhāvaḥ sarūpaḥ | prasavadharmi [evaṃ] pradhānaṃ vyaktañca sarūpamiti | mahānahaṅkāraṃ prasūte | ahaṅkāraḥ pañcatanmātrāṇi prasūte | yāvatpañcamahābhūtāni | pradhānaṃ mahāntaṃ prasūte iti vyaktāvyaktayoḥ sārūpyam‌ | pumān‌ sārūpyavairūpyaviparīta iti | vyaktāvyaktayoḥ ṣaḍvidhaṃ sārūpyamasti | puruṣasya naitatsārūpyamasti | tasmātsārūpyaviparītaḥ vairūpyaviparītaśceti | vyaktāvyaktayornavavidhaṃ vairūpya[mukta]m‌ | tatrāṣṭavidhaviparītaḥ pumān‌ | ta uktaṃ vairūpyaviparīta iti | puruṣāṇāmanekatvānna pradhānasārūpyam‌ || 11 || para āha | vyaktamavyaktañca triguṇamuktam‌ | ime trayo guṇāḥ kimātmakāḥ | āryayā uttarayati | prītyaprītiviṣādātmakāḥ prakāśapravṛttiniyamārthāḥ | anyonyābhibhavāśrayajananamithunavṛttayaśca guṇāḥ || 12 || prītyaprītiviṣādātmakā iti | sattvaṃ rajastama itīme trayo guṇāḥ | prītiḥ sattvasyātmā | rajaso'prītirātmā | tamaso viṣāda ātmā | iti trayaḥ svabhāvā dṛśyante | prakāśapravṛttiniyamārthā iti | kiṃ kurvanti ime trayo guṇāḥ | ādyaḥ prakāśaṃ prabhāṃ kartuṃ samarthaḥ | madhyamastu jananaṃ pravṛttiṃ kartuṃ samarthaḥ | antimaḥ niyamaṃ bandhaṃ kartuṃ samarthaḥ | idaṃ triguṇānvayaṃ kāryam‌ | anyonyābhibhavāśrayajananamithunavṛttayaśca triguṇadharmā iti | ke dharmāstriguṇasya | teṣāṃ dharmāḥ pañcavidhāḥ | anyonyābhibhaveti | sattvamutkaṭañced‌ rajastamasī abhibhavati | yathā mahān‌ sūryaraśmiścandranakṣatrādīnabhibhavati | raja utkaṭañcet‌ sattvatamasī abhibhavati | yathā prakāśamānaḥ sūryaraśmiḥ nakṣatrāṇi candrañcābhibhavati | tama utkaṭañced‌ rajassattve abhibhavati | yathā sūryasya mahatā prakāśena nakṣatrāṇāṃ candrasya ca prakāśo na dṛśyate | anyonyāśrayeti | ime guṇāḥ parasparāśrayāḥ sarvakāryakaraṇasamarthāḥ | yathā tridaṇḍī parasparāśrayā kuṇḍikādīnavaṣṭabhnāti | anyonyajananeti | kadācitsattvaṃ rajastamasī janayati | kadācid‌ rajassattvatamasī janayati | kadācittamo rajassattve janayati | yathā trayaḥ puruṣāḥ parasparamāśrayanyo yugapadekamarthaṃ kurvanti | tathā mahadādisthā guṇāḥ parasparamāśrayantaḥ saṃhatya jananamaraṇe kurvanti | anyonyamithuneti | sattvaṃ kadācidrajasā mithunaṃ, kadācit‌ tamasā mithunam‌ | rajaḥ kadācitsattvena mithunaṃ, kadācit‌ tamasā mithunam‌ | evaṃ tamo'pi kadācitsattvena mithunaṃ, kadācidrajasā mithunam‌ | yathoktā gāthā vyāsamaharṣiṇā | rajaso mithunaṃ sattvaṃ sattvasya mithunaṃ rajaḥ | ubhayoḥ sattvarajasormithunaṃ tama ucyate || iti | anyonyavṛttīti | ime trayo guṇāḥ anyonyamarthaṃ kurvanti | yathā rājakulastrī supriyarūpaśīlā | ayaṃ sattvaguṇa ucyate | etatsattvapariṇataṃ rūpaṃ bharturbandhośca prītiṃ karoti | idaṃ svārthakaraṇamucyate | [saiva] sarvāsāṃ sapatnīnāṃ śokaṃ janayati | idamanyārthakaraṇamucyate | anyeṣāṃ viṣādamapi janayati | yathā dāsyādayaḥ sadā tatparicaryākhinnā mocanamalabhamānā viṣādāviṣṭacittā bhavanti | idamucyate anyārthajananam‌ | idameva sattvaguṇasya svaparārthakaraṇamucyate | rajaḥ svaparārthaṃ janayati | yathā kaściccoro rājakulastriyaṃ badhnāti | tadā rājavaṃśyo'śvārūḍho daṇḍaṃ gṛhītvā āgamya paritrāyate | rājavaṃśyo rajaḥpariṇataḥ | rājavaṃśyo bhayagocaro'pi striyaḥ ahaṃ mocanaṃ lapsye ityānandaṃ janayati | idamanyārthajananam‌ | anye corā rājadarśanāt‌ sthāṇuvanna calanti | idamucyate'nyeṣāṃ mohajananam‌ | rajaḥ svaparārthaṃ janayatītyuktam‌ | tamaḥ svaparārthaṃ janayati | yathā mahān‌ ghanaḥ kṛṣṇameghaḥ vidyudādīnārabhate | meghastamaḥpariṇataḥ | sarve kṛṣīvalā dhānyopajīvino modante | idamucyate'nyārthajananam‌ | mohamapi janayati | yathā kācidyuvatiḥ bhartṛviyuktā imaṃ meghaṃ vidyutañca dṛṣṭvā khidyate bhartā na pratinivṛtta iti | striyo mohaṃ janayati [megha] itīdamucyate svārthajananam‌ | śokamapi janayati | yathā vaṇijaḥ pathi vartamānāḥ saṃklinnā bhāravahanāsamarthā khinnahṛdayā bhavanti | idamucyate'nyārthajananam‌ | evaṃ pañcavidhāstriguṇānvayā dharmāḥ || 12 || kiñcāsti guṇānāṃ lakṣaṇam‌ | sattvaṃ laghu prakāśakamiṣṭamupaṣṭambhakaṃ calañca rajaḥ | guru varaṇakameva tamaḥ pradīpavaccārthato vṛttiḥ || 13 || sattvaṃ laghuprakāśakalakṣaṇamiṣṭamiti | laghu sūkṣmam‌ | prakāśakaṃ pradīpakam‌ | tat‌ sattvamākhyātam‌ | sattvamutkaṭañcet‌ sarvāṇīndriyāṇi laghūni mṛdūni viṣayagrahaṇasamarthāni bhavanti | tadā mantavyaṃ sattvamutkaṭamiti | raja upaṣṭambhakacalalakṣaṇamiṣṭamiti | upaṣṭambhakamunmanaḥ anyāvigaṇayitṛ | yathā mattagajaḥ kalahaḥ mṛgayamāṇaḥ dviṣantaṃ gajamāgataṃ sthagayate | raja utkaṭañcet‌ tadā manuṣyaḥ sadā kalahaṃ mṛgayate | sadā calacitta ekatrāvasthānāsamarthaśca bhavati | tadā mantavyaṃ rajoguṇa utkaṭa iti | kāryam‌ | ayaṃ ghaṭo jalatailādidhāraṇe samarthaḥ | na tu mṛtpiṇḍaḥ | ayaṃ kāraṇakāryavibhāgaḥ | tantupaṭāvapyevam‌ | tathā mahadādi vyaktamavaśyaṃ kāryam‌ | etatkāryaṃ dṛṣṭvā jānīmo vyatiriktaṃ kāraṇaṃ virūpamastīti | tasmādasti pradhānam‌ | vaiśvarūpyasyāvibhāgāditi | kiñcāsti kāraṇāntaram‌ asti pradhānaṃ vastuta iti jñāpayitum‌ | vaiśvarūpyasyeti | trividho hi loko yaduta pṛthivī antarikṣaṃ dyauriti | pralayakāle sarvo loko'vibhaktaḥ | pañcamahābhūtāni ekādaśendriyāṇi pañcatanmātreṣu vilīya avibhaktāni | yāvanmahān‌ pradhāne vilīya avibhaktaḥ | idaṃ vyaktamidaṃ pradhānamiti [vivicya] na vaktuṃ śakyate | pralayakāle vyaktasyābhāvātpradhānamapi avidyamānaṃ bhavet‌ | pradhānaṃ yadi nāsti | saṃsāro'pi na bhavet‌ | naitadyujyate | yatastrividhalokasya punassargasamarthaṃ pradhānamasti | ato jānīmaḥ pradhānamastīti | [evaṃ] pañcahetubhyaḥ pradhānaṃ sthāpitam‌ || 15 || para āha | yadi pradhānamasti | [tathāpi] na vyaktaṃ janayituṃ śaknoti | nissahāyatvāt‌ | yathā ekaḥ puruṣaḥ putraṃ janayituṃ na śaknoti | ekastanturna paṭaṃ janayituṃ śaknoti | tathā pradhānamapi | āryayottaramāha | kāraṇamastyavyaktaṃ pravartate triguṇataḥ samudayācca | pariṇāmataḥ salilavat‌ pratipratiguṇāśrayaviśeṣāt‌ || 16 || avyaktaṃ vyaktajananakāraṇamiti | pradhānaṃ triguṇayuktatvād‌ vyaktaṃ janayituṃ śaknotītyarthaḥ | pradhānasyeme guṇā na santi [cet‌] | tadā bhavaduktaṃ satyaṃ syāt‌ | yadi santi trayo guṇāḥ, [tadā] saṃyogābhāvād‌ vyaktaṃ janayituṃ na śaknotītyetanna yujyeta | trayo guṇāssamuditā vyaktaṃ janayanti iti | yathā bahavastantavaḥ samuditāḥ paṭaṃ janayanti | tathā trayo guṇā api parasparāśritatvād‌ vyaktaṃ janayanti | para āha | loke jananaṃ dvividham‌ | pariṇāmajaṃ, yathā dugdhādijaṃ dadhyādi | apariṇāmajaṃ, yathā mātāpitṛjaḥ putraḥ | pradhānajaṃ vyaktaṃ kasya kāraṇajasya sambandhi iṣyate | uttaramāha | pariṇāmataḥ dugdhadadhivat‌ | pradhānaṃ vyaktaṃ pariṇamati | yadeva vyaktaṃ tadeva pradhānam‌ | ato na bhinnajātīyajamiha svīkriyate | para āha | yadyekaṃ kāraṇaṃ, na bahuvidhaṃ kāryaṃ janayituṃ śaknuyāt‌ | eṣvartheṣu pradhānamekañcet‌ kathaṃ trividhaṃ lokaṃ janaye‌t‌ | divi jātā[śce]ttadā sukhinaḥ | manuṣyajātāstu duḥkhinaḥ | tiryagjātāstu mūḍhā iti | yadyekasmātkāraṇājjāyate | kathaṃ tridhā vargo labhyate | samādhīyate | salilavat‌ pratipratiguṇaviśeṣāt‌ | divyamādāvekarasaṃ jalaṃ prāpnoti medinīm‌ | nānārasaṃ pariṇamati pṛthak‌ pṛthagbhājanaviśeṣāt‌ || yadi suvarṇabhājane vartate | tadraso'timadhuraḥ | yadi pṛthivīṃ prāpnoti | pṛthivīgandhamanusṛtya raso nānā bhavati, na samaḥ | tathā trividho loko'pi [na samaḥ] | ekasmātpradhānādutpannasya [api] triguṇavaiṣamyāt‌ | divi sattvaṃ viśālam‌ | ato devāḥ sadā sukhamanubhavanti | manuṣyeṣu rajo viśālam‌ | ato manuṣyāḥ bahu duḥkhamanubhavanti | tiryaggateṣu tamo viśālam‌ | atastiryagādayaḥ sadā mūḍhāḥ | āsu gatiṣu sarvatra guṇāḥ sadā saṃyuktāḥ | autkaṭyānautkaṭyābhyāṃ tathā viśeṣaḥ | evamekaṃ pradhānaṃ trīn‌ lokāñjanayati | triguṇavaiṣamyāttu tāratamyam‌ || 16 || pradhānamavasitam‌ | athedānīṃ puruṣaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | puruṣaḥ pradhānavatsūkṣmaḥ | kathaṃ jānīmaḥ puruṣo'stīti prakāśayitumimāmāryāmāha | saṅghātaparārthatvāt‌ triguṇādiviparyayādadhiṣṭhānāt‌ | puruṣo'sti bhoktṛbhāvātkaivalyārthaṃ pravṛtteśca || 17 || bhoktṛbhāvātkaivalyā[rthaṃ pravṛtte]śca itīme pañca hetavaḥ sādhayanti puruṣo'stīti || saṅghātaparārthatvāditi | yathā vyaktāvyaktajña[vijñānā]n‌ mokṣo labhyate tathā prathamāryāyāmuktam‌ | kiñca pradhānavyaktasādhanāni pañca hetavaḥ samyak‌ pratipāditāḥ | atha puruṣo'tisūkṣmaḥ sādhayitavyaḥ | asti puruṣaḥ saṅghātaparārthatvāt‌ | loke hi vayaṃ paśyāmaḥ sarvaḥ saṅghātaḥ parārtha iti | yathā śayanāsanādayaḥ saṅghātā na svārthāḥ avaśyaṃ parārthāḥ kalpitāḥ | astyanya upabhojakaḥ | tadarthā gṛhādisaṅghātāścaivam‌ | tathā mahadādyapi | pañcabhūtasaṅghāto deha ākhyāyate | ayaṃ deho na svārthaḥ | [kintu] ekāntataḥ parārtho'dhyavasīyate | puruṣa eva paraḥ | ato jānīmo'sti puruṣa iti | triguṇaviparyayāditi | pradhānavyaktayoḥ ṣaḍvidhaṃ sārūpyamuktaṃ pūrvamāryāyām‌ | [yathā] triguṇamaviveki viṣayaḥ sāmānyamacetanaṃ prasavadharmi | vyaktaṃ tathā pradhānaṃ tadviparītastathā ca pumān‌ || iti || etatṣaṭkaviparyayāducyate'sti puruṣa iti | adhiṣṭhānāditi | yadi dehamimaṃ puruṣo'dhitiṣṭhati | tadā dehaśceṣṭate | yadi nāsti dehasyādhiṣṭhātā puruṣaḥ | tadā na ceṣṭate | yathoktaṃ ṣaṣṭivargatantre | puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ pradhānaṃ vyaktaṃ janayati | iti | tasmājjānīmo'sti puruṣa iti | bhoktṛbhāvāditi | yathā loke ṣaḍrasaṃ pānaṃ bhojanaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā jñāyate astyanyo bhokteti | tathā mahadādi dṛṣṭvā jñāyate'vaśyamanyena bhoktrā bhavitavyaṃ yasya bhojana[mida]m‌ | tasmājjānīmo'sti puruṣa iti | kaivalyā[rthaṃ pravṛtte]śceti | yadi dehamātramasti | āryajanopadiṣṭo mokṣopāyo nirarthaka eva syāt‌ | yathā purā kaścidṛṣirbrāhmaṇānupagamyaivamuvāca | sarve [yūyaṃ] vedadhanāḥ sarve ca somapāyinaḥ | sarve dṛṣṭātmajamukhā bhikṣudharmamathecchatha || iti | yadi dehamātramasti | kimarthamidaṃ [vacanam‌] | ato jānīmo dehavyatirikta ātmā svabhāvato'stīti | yadi nāstyanya ātmā, dehamātramasti | tadā mātāpitrācāryāṇāṃ pūjyānāṃ maraṇānantaramutsṛṣṭādehā yadi dahyante khanyante vā, evaṃ paryupāsyante | tadā pāpaṃ labhyeta | na puṇyaguṇaḥ syāt‌ | etadarthaṃ jānīmo'styanya ātmeti | kiñcāsti āptavacanam‌ | majjāsthinī rajjusthūṇau bhavataḥ, raktamāṃse mṛtpāṃsū bhavataḥ | aśucyanityaṃ duḥkhaṃ [śarīraṃ] prabhurātmā etatsambandhavarjitaḥ || tyaja dharmamadharmaṃ vāpi tyājyaṃ tucchasatyakam‌ | tyāgabhāvo'pi tyaktavyaḥ viśuddhāḥ kevalaiśitā || iti | yadyātmā nāsti | kaivalyaṃ na varteta | asmādāptāgamātpuruṣo niyatamastīti jānīmaḥ | imān‌ pañcahetūnāśritya puruṣāstitvaṃ sādhitam‌ || 17 || para āha | puruṣaḥ kiṃ bahuśarīreṣu saṃhatyaiko lakṣyate [uta] pratiśarīramekaḥ puruṣaḥ | yadyucyate kathamevaṃ saṃśaya iti | ācāryāṇāṃ mitho viruddhavāditvāt‌ | kaścidāha | ekaḥ puruṣaḥ sarvaśarīrāṇi vyāpnoti | maṇigrathanasūtravat‌ | maṇayo bahavaḥ sūtramekam‌ | yathā ca viṣṇurekaḥ strīṣaṣṭisahasraiḥ samamekasmin‌ samaye ramate | tathā puruṣo'pyekaḥ sarvaśarīrāṇi vyāpnoti | iti | anyaḥ kaścidācāryaḥ punarāha | pratiśarīraṃ bhinna ātmāstīti | tasmānmama saṃśayo jātaḥ | samādhīyate | bahavaḥ puruṣāḥ | pratiśarīraṃ pṛthak‌ pṛthak‌ puruṣo'sti | kathamevaṃ jñāyate | āryayā vivṛṇoti | janmamaraṇakaraṇānāṃ pratiniyamādayugapatpravṛtteśca | puruṣabahutvaṃ siddhaṃ traiguṇyaviparyayāccaiva || 18 || janmamaraṇakaraṇānāṃ pratiniyamāditi | yadi puruṣa ekaḥ | tadā ekasmin‌ jāyamāne sarve jāyeran‌ | sarvatra sarvāḥ striyo garbhiṇyaḥ syuḥ prasavavatyaḥ syuḥ putravatyaḥ syuḥ putrīvatyaśca syuḥ | naivaṃ bhavanti yugapadekasmin‌ samaye pratiprativilakṣaṇāḥ [satyaḥ] | tasmājjānīmo bahavaḥ puruṣā iti | kiñca [yadi] puruṣa ekaḥ, ekasmin‌ mriyamāṇe sarve'pi mriyeran‌ | etadarthāsambhavājjñāyate naikaḥ puruṣa iti | kiñca karaṇānāṃ pratiniyamāt | yadyekaḥ puruṣaḥ, ekasmin‌ badhire sarve'pi badhirāḥ syuḥ | sarve'pi andhamūkakāṇādayaśca syurekasmin‌ samaye | tathātvāsambhavājjñāyate bahavaḥ puruṣā iti | kiñca traiguṇyavibhedāt | yadi puruṣa ekaḥ, traiguṇyamavilakṣaṇaṃ syāt‌ | yathā eko brāhmaṇastrīn‌ putrān‌ janayati | eko medhāvī sukhī ca | dvitīyaḥ kopano duḥkhī ca | tṛtīyastāmaso mūḍhaśca | yadyekaḥ puruṣa ekasmin‌ sāttvike sarve samaṃ sāttvikāḥ [syuḥ] | duḥkhini mūḍhe caivam‌ | [ato yad‌] uktaṃ bhavatā puruṣa eko maṇigrathana[sūtra]vad‌ viṣṇuvacceti | naitadyujyate | tasmāt‌ hetupañcakena jānīmo bahavaḥ puruṣā iti || 18 || para āha | mamātra saṃśayaḥ | [ki]mayaṃ puruṣaḥ kartā vā akartā veti | yadyucyate kathamayaṃ saṃśaya iti | lokavyavahārāt‌ | loko hi vadati puruṣo gacchati puruṣa āgacchati puruṣaḥ karteti | sāṅkhyā vadanti puruṣa akarteti | vaiśeṣikā vadanti puruṣaḥ karteti | tasmānmama saṃśayaḥ | samādhīyate | puruṣaḥ akarteti | kathaṃ jñāyate | āryayā vivṛṇoti | tasmācca viparyāsāt‌ siddhaṃ sākṣitvamasya puruṣasya | kaivalyaṃ mādhyasthyaṃ draṣṭṛtvamakartṛbhāvaśca || 19 || vyaktāvyaktaviparyāsāditi | pūrvasminnāryādvaya uktaṃ puruṣaḥ pradhānādbhinnaḥ vyaktādatiriktaśceti | tadubhayalakṣaṇaviparyāsāt‌, ubhayavaiṣamyāt‌ | trayo guṇāḥ kartāraḥ | tattriguṇavibhinnatvād‍‌ akarteti | para āha | kiṃ prayojanamanena iti | ucyate | sākṣitvasya sthāpanāt‌ | puruṣasya sākṣitvaṃ siddham‌ | puruṣasya jñātṛtvāt‌ | nāvaśiṣṭāni tattvāni tathā | kaivalyamiti | prakṛtivikārābhyāṃ bhede sati puruṣasya pariśuddhatvāt kaivalyam‌ | mādhyasthyamiti | triguṇabhinnatvād‌ guṇānāṃ ca saṃkocavikāsavaiṣamyān‌ mādhyasthyamiṣyate [puruṣasya] | yathaikaḥ parivrājakaḥ kevala ekatra sthito gatāgatamanyaṃ nānusarati [kintu] kevalaṃ paśyati | tathā trayo guṇāḥ saṃkocavikāsajananamaraṇasamarthāḥ | kevalamekaḥ puruṣaḥ paśyati tathāvyāpārān‌ | tasmānmādhyasthyamiṣyate | prakṛtivikārabhinnatvāt‌ puruṣasya sacetanatvād‌ draṣṭṛtvamucyate | tadvyāpāratvāddraṣṭetyucyate na karteti | ato guṇāḥ kurvanti ityayamarthaḥ siddhaḥ | asti puruṣaḥ | sa cāneko'kartā ityayamartho'pi siddhaḥ || 19 || para āha | yadyakartā puruṣaḥ, ko'dhyavasāyaṃ karoti dharmaṃ cariṣyāmīti | aniṣṭaṃ parihariṣyāmi praṇidhānaṃ vā sādhayiṣyāmīti ko'dhyavasāyaṃ karoti | yadi trayo guṇāḥ kurvanti tamadhyavasāyam‌ | eṣāṃ sacetanatvaṃ bhavet‌ | [nedamiṣṭam‌] guṇānāmacetanatvasya prāgupanyāsāt‌ | yadi puruṣo'dhyavasāyaṃ karoti | tadā puruṣaḥ kartā siddhyet‌ | [na caitadiṣṭam‌] puruṣasyākartṛtvasya prāgupanyāsāt‌ | tasmādubhayathā doṣo bhavati | āryayottaramāha | tasmāttatsaṃyogādacetanaṃ cetanāvadiva liṅgam‌ | guṇakartṛtve'pi tathā karteva bhavatyudāsīnaḥ || 20 || trayo guṇāḥ puruṣasaṃyogāditi | ime guṇā acetanāḥ kurvanti | puruṣaḥ sacetano na karoti | anayordvayoḥ saṃyogādguṇāścetanāvanta iva [bhavanti] | yathā dagdho ghaṭo'gninā saṃyukta uṣṇaḥ, salilena saṃyuktaḥ śītaḥ | tathā trayo guṇāścetanāvatā saṃyuktāścetanāvanta iva kurvantyadhyavasāyam‌ | ata uktamacetanāścetanāvanta iveti | [yad‌] uktaṃ bhavatā lokavyavahārāt‌ puruṣaḥ kartā iti | tamarthaṃ samādadhmaḥ | triguṇakartṛtvādudāsīnaḥ karteva [bhavatī]ti | tatsaṃyogādakartā kartetyucyate | yathā kaścidbrāhmaṇo bhramāccorasaṃghamadhyaṃ praviṣṭaḥ | core hantuṃ gṛhīte so'pi saha hantuṃ gṛhītaḥ | coreṇa saha gamanāt‌ coranāma labhyate | tathā puruṣo'pi kartrānubaddhaḥ lokavyavahāreṇocyate puruṣaḥ karteti || 20 || para āha | prakṛtipuruṣau kena hetunā saṃyuktau | āryayā uttaramāha | puruṣasya darśanārthaṃ kaivalyārthaṃ tathā pradhānasya | paṅgvandhavadubhayorapi saṃyogastatkṛtaḥ sargaḥ || 21 || puruṣastriguṇadarśanārthīti | puruṣa evaṃ manyate ahaṃ triguṇaṃ pradhānaṃ drakṣyāmīti | ataḥ puruṣaḥ pradhānena saṃyujyate | pradhānaṃ kaivalyārthamiti | [pradhānamevaṃ manyate] ayaṃ tapasvī puruṣaḥ kevalaḥ jñānadarśanaśaktimān‌ | tasya kaivalyaṃ prāpayiṣyāmīti | tadarthaṃ pradhānapuruṣau saṃyujyete | yathā rājā puruṣeṇa saṃyujyate imaṃ puruṣaṃ niyokṣya iti | sa puruṣo'pi rājñā saṃyujyate | rājā me vṛttiṃ dāsyatīti | ato rājapuruṣayoḥ saṃyogo'rthavaśātsiddhaḥ | tathā pradhānapuruṣayoḥ saṃyuktatvamapi | puruṣasya darśanārthaṃ pradhānasya kaivalyārthaṃ paṅgvandhavatsaṃyogaḥ | atra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | purā kila vaṇiksārtha ujjayinīṃ prasthitaḥ caurairabhihataḥ pṛthak‌ viśliṣṭo jagāma | [tadā] eko jātyandhaḥ eko jātipaṅguśca sarvajanotsṛṣṭāvāstām‌ | andhaḥ samantāccaṅkramamāṇaḥ āsīnena paṅgunā dṛṣṭaḥ | paṅgurapṛcchat‌ | kastvamiti | andhaḥ pratyavadat‌ | ahaṃ jātyandhaḥ na jānāmi yena samantāccaṅkrame | tvaṃ punaḥ kaḥ | paṅguḥ pratyavadat‌ | ahaṃ jātipaṅguḥ mārgadarśanamātrakṣamaḥ asamartho gantumiti | [jātyandho'vadat‌] tasmānmama skandha upaviśa | ahaṃ mārgaṃ netuṃ śaknomi | tvaṃ mama panthānaṃ darśaya | iti | evaṃ dvau puruṣau mithaḥsaṃyogena [svā]dhiṣṭhānadeśamabhyagacchatām‌ | tayoḥ saṃyogo'rthavaśāt‌ siddhaḥ | gatvā ca tau [svā]dhiṣṭhānadeśaṃ pṛthak‌ pṛthag‌ vyayujyetām‌ | tathā puruṣaḥ pradhānadarśanakāla eva mokṣaṃ labhate | pradhānamapi puruṣasya kaivalyaṃ kṛtvā pṛthaṅnivartate | arthavaśāllokasarga iti | puruṣaḥ anyadarśanārthaṃ pradhānaṃ kaivalyārthaṃ saṃyujyete | ayaṃ saṃyogaḥ lokaṃ sṛjati | yathā strīpuruṣobhayasaṃyogātputraḥ saṃbhavati | tathā pradhānapuruṣasaṃyogo mahadādi sṛjati || 21 || para āha | saṃyogo lokaṃ sṛjatītyuktam‌ | ayaṃ sargaḥ punaḥ kīdṛśaḥ | āryayottaramāha | prakṛtermahān‌ tato'haṅkārastasmādgaṇaśca ṣoḍaśakaḥ | tasmādapi ṣoḍaśakātpañcabhyaḥ pañcabhūtāni || 22 || prakṛteḥ krameṇa jāyata iti | prakṛtiriti pradhānaṃ vā brahma vā bahudhātmakaṃ vākhyāyate | yadi krameṇa jāyate | tadā prakṛtermūlatvānnāsti [anyad‌] yato jāyeta | prakṛtermahān‌ prathamamutpadyate | mahāniti buddhirvā saṃvittirvā vibhurvā matirvā prajñā vākhyāyate | yatra mahān‌ tatra matiḥ | ato mahān‌ matirityākhyāṃ labhate | tato mahato'haṅkāro jāyate | ahaṅkāra iti bhūtādirvā vaikṛto vā taijaso vākhyāyate | tato'haṅkārāt‌ ṣoḍaśaka utpadyate | ṣoḍaśaka iti pañcatanmātrāṇi pañcajñānendriyāṇi pañcakarmendriyāṇi mana indriyañca | pañcatanmātrāṇi śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ, ime pañcatanmātrātmakāḥ tanmātraśaktayo vā | śrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇāni pañca jñānendriyāṇi | vākpāṇipādopasthapāyavaḥ pañca karmendriyāṇi | ayaṃ ṣoḍaśakaḥ ahaṅkārādutpadyate | ata uktaṃ mahān‌ [tataḥ] ahaṅkāraḥ [tataḥ] ṣoḍaśaka iti | atha ṣoḍaśake santi pañca[tanmātrāṇi] tebhyaḥ pañcabhūtāni jāyante | [tatra] śabdatanmātrādākāśamahābhūtamutpadyate | sparśatanmātrādvāyumahābhūtamutpadyate | rūpatanmātrāttejomahābhūtamutpadyate | rasatanmātrād‌ ambhamahābhūtamutpadyate | gandhatanmātrātpṛthivīmahābhūtamutpadyate | prakṛtivikṛtipuruṣān‌ trīn‌ dharmān‌ dṛṣṭā mokṣo labhyate ityavocam‌ || 22 || para āha | prakṛtermahānutpadyata ityuktam‌ | mahān‌ kiṃlakṣaṇakaḥ | āryayottaramāha | adhyavasāyo buddhirdharmo jñānaṃ virāga aiśvaryam‌ | sāttvikametadrūpaṃ tāmasamasmādviparyastam‌ || 23 || adhyavasāyo mahānucyata iti | ko nāmādhyavasāyaḥ | yadutāyaṃ sthāṇuḥ ayaṃ puruṣa iti | īdṛśī buddhiradhyavasāya ucyate | adhyavasāya eva mahānucyate | ayaṃ mahānaṣṭāṅgaḥ | catvāri aṅgāni sāttvikāni | catvāri tāmasāni | sāttvikāni aṅgāni yaduta dharmo jñānaṃ virāga āryayottaramāha | sāttvika ekādaśakaḥ pravartate vaikṛtādahaṅkārāt‌ | bhūtādestanmātraḥ sa tāmasastaijasādubhayam‌ || 25 || ekādaśakaḥ sāttviko vaikṛtādahaṅkārātpravartata iti | buddhau tāni sattvabahulāni laghuprakāśaviśuddhāni svaviṣayagrahaṇasamarthāni | atastānyekādaśa sāttvikāni ityucyante | bhūtādestāmasastanmātraḥ pravartata iti | mahati tama utkaṭañcet‌, tadā ahaṅkāramutpādayati | sattvarajasī abhibhavati | ayamahaṅkārastāmasaḥ | ata āryā bhūtādiṃ nāma [taṃ] vadanti | ayamahaṅkāraḥ pañcatanmātrāṇyutpādayati | ataḥ pañcatanmātrāṇi pañcamahābhūtāni ca sarvāṇi tāmasajātīyāni | taijasādubhayaṃ pravartate | iti | mahati raja utkaṭañcet‌, tadā ahaṅkāraṃ janayati | sattvatamasī abhibhavati | so'haṅkāro rājasaḥ | ata āryāḥ [tasya] taijasamiti nāma vyavasthāpayanti | ayamahaṅkāra ubhayamutpādayati | ekādaśendriyāṇi pañcatanmātrādīni cotpādayati | sātvikavaikṛtiko'haṅkāra indriyāṇāmutpādakastaijasamahaṅkāraṃ sahāyaṃ gṛhṇāti | kathamevam‌ | taijasaḥ sakriyatvena vikṛtaḥ | sāttvikaḥ niṣkriyatvena vikṛtaḥ | [ataḥ] ahaṅkāro yadā ekādaśendriyāṇyutpādayati | avaśyaṃ taijasamahaṅkāraṃ sahāyaṃ gṛhṇāti | bhūtādyahaṅkāro yadā pañcatanmātrāṇi pañcamahābhūtāni cotpādayati | avaśyaṃ taijasamahaṅkāraṃ sahāyaṃ gṛhṇāti | kathamevam‌ | tāmasāhaṅkārasya niṣkriyatvāt‌ taijasasya sakriyatvāt‌ | evaṃ taijaso'haṅkāra ekādaśendriyāṇyutpādayati pañcatanmātrāṇi cotpādayati | ata uktaṃ taijasādubhayaṃ pravartata iti || 25 || para āha | sāttvika ekādaśendriyāṇyutpādayatītyuktam‌ | kānyekādaśendriyāṇi | āryayottaramāha | buddhīndriyāṇi śrotratvakcakṣūrasananāsikākhyāni | vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthān‌ karmendriyāṇyāhuḥ || 26 || śrotraṃ tvak‌ cakṣūrasanaṃ nāsikā, imāni pañca buddhīndriyākhyāni iti | kathamucyate [buddhī]ndriyamiti | tāni pañca śabdarūpādigrahaṇasamarthatvād‌ buddhīndriyāṇi nāma ucyante | vāk‌ pāṇiḥ pādaḥ pāyurupasthaḥ [imāni] pañca karmendriyā[khyāni] iti | kathamucyate karmendriyamiti | bhāṣaṇādivṛttīrimāni pañca kurvanti | tasmātpūrvācāryaiḥ pañca karmendriyāṇīti nāma vyavasthāpitam‌ | para āha | eṣāṃ daśendriyāṇāṃ kīdṛśyaḥ svavṛttayo bhavanti | śrotrendriyaṃ śabdatanmātrādutpannamākāśamahābhūtasajātīyam‌ | ataḥ kevalaṃ śabdaṃ gṛhṇāti | tvagindriyaṃ sparśatanmātrādutpannaṃ vāyumahābhūtasajātīyam‌ | ataḥ kevalaṃ sparśaṃ gṛhṇāti | cakṣurindriyaṃ rūpatanmātrādutpannaṃ tejomahābhūtasajātīyam‌ | ataḥ kevalaṃ rūpaṃ gṛhṇāti | rasanendriyaṃ rasatanmātrādutpannamambhamahābhūtasajātīyam‌ | ataḥ kevalaṃ rasaṃ gṛhṇāti | nāsikendriyaṃ gandhatanmātrādutpannaṃ pṛthivīmahābhūtasajātīyam‌ | ataḥ kevalaṃ gandhaṃ gṛhṇāti | [evaṃ] pañcakarmendriyāṇāṃ pañca vṛttayaḥ santi | vāgindriyaṃ buddhīndriyasaṃyuktaṃ nāmapadavyañjanāni vaktuṃ śaknoti | pāṇīndriyaṃ buddhīndriyasaṃyuktamādānadhāraṇādikarmāṇi suṣṭhu kartuṃ śaknoti | pādendriyaṃ buddhīndriyasaṃyuktaṃ samanimnonnatamārge kramituṃ śaknoti | upasthendriyaṃ buddhīndriyasaṃyuktamānandayati putrañca janayati | pāyvindriyaṃ buddhīndriyasaṃyuktaṃ purīṣaṃ malañcotsṛjati | etadarthaṃ daśendriyāṇyucyante || 26 || para āha | kīdṛśaṃ mana indriyam‌ | āryayottaramāha | ubhayātmakamatra manaḥ saṃkalpakamindriyañca sādharmyāt‌ | guṇapariṇāmaviśeṣānnānātvaṃ grāhyabhedācca || 27 || saṃkalpakaṃ mana indriyamubhayavidhamucyata iti | mana indriyamubhayavidhaṃ saṃkalpātmakam‌ | kathamevam‌ | idaṃ mana indriyaṃ yadā buddhīndriyeṇa saṃyuktaṃ, tadā buddhīndriyamityākhyāyate yadā karmendriyeṇa saṃyuktaṃ tadā karmendriyamityākhyāyate | kasmāt‌ | yasmād‌ idaṃ mana indriyaṃ buddhīndriyavṛtiṃ saṃkalpayati | karmendriyavṛttiṃ ca saṃkalpayati | yathā ekaḥ puruṣaḥ kadācitkarmakara ucyate | kadācitpravaktā | evaṃ mana indriyamapi | idaṃ manaḥ kathamindriyamucyate | [taddhi] daśendriyasadharma | daśendriyāṇi vaikṛtādahaṅkārādutpadyante | evaṃ mana indriyamapi | daśendriyasamavṛtti ca | yad‌ daśendriyāṇi kurvanti, [tat‌] mana indriyamapi samaṃ karoti | tasmādindriyamiti nāma labhate | para āha | indriyāṇāṃ vṛttayaḥ pratyekaṃ vilakṣaṇāḥ, mana-indriyasya pratiniyatā vā na vā | ucyate | yaḥ saṃkalpaḥ saiva tasya vṛttiḥ | tadyathā, kaścitpuruṣaḥ kutracitpradeśe dhanamannaṃ vāstīti śṛṇvan‌ manasi vadati ahaṃ tatra gatvā annaṃ tato lābhañca lapsye iti | etādṛśasaṃkalpo mana indriyasya pratiniyatā vṛttiḥ | utpattisāmyādvṛttisāmyāt‌ saṃkalpavṛttipratiniyamācca tadindriyamityākhyāyate | tasmādindriyānyekādaśavidhānyeva | para āha | indriyāṇāmekādaśānāmeṣāṃ kaḥ kartā | yadyucyate kathamayaṃ saṃśaya iti | ācāryāṇāṃ pratipattivaiṣamyāt‌ | kecidāhuḥ | puruṣakṛtānīti | kecidāhuḥ | īśvarakṛtānīti | kecidāhuḥ | [sva]bhāvakṛtānīti | vṛttiḥ | vyānavāyuśśarīraṃ vyāpnoti | ante ca śarīraṃ muñcati | ayaṃ vāyuryadi bahulaḥ, tadā puruṣo nānyaṃ hitvā ramate | ayaṃ vāyuryadi kiñcit‌ kiñcit‌ muñcati | [tadā] aṅgāni mṛtavadbhavanti | atyantamocanañcet‌ tato maraṇam‌ | samānavāyurhṛddeśe tiṣṭhati | [āhāra] samānayanasamarthaḥ | saiva tasya vṛttiḥ | ayaṃ vāyuryadi bahulaḥ | puruṣo lubdho bhavati | dhanaṃ mṛgayati | sahacarīñca mṛgayate | imāḥ pañcaprāṇavṛttayastrayodaśendriyakṛtāḥ || 29 || trayodaśendriyāṇāmeṣāmasāmānyā [sāmānyā] ca vṛttiruktā | idānīṃ yugapadvṛttiḥ kramaśo vṛttiśca vakṣyate | āryayā tāmāha | yugapaccatuṣṭayasya hi vṛttiḥ kramaśaśca tasya nirdiṣṭā | dṛṣṭe tathāpyadṛṣṭe trayasya tatpūrvikā vṛttiḥ || 30 || buddhyahaṅkāramanasāmindriyasya ca yugapatkramaśo vā vṛttiriti | rūpadarśane yugapanmahadahaṅkāramanaścakṣurindriyāṇi saha pravṛttāni ekaṃ prameyaṃ gṛhṇanti | yathā cakṣustathāvaśiṣṭānīndriyāṇyapi | yugapaccatvāri saha pravartante | ekaṃ prameyaṃ samaṃ gṛhṇanti | kramaśo vṛttiḥ, yathā kaścit‌ pathi gacchan‌ haṭhādunnataṃ vastu kiñcit‌ dṛṣṭvā tadā utpannasaṃśayo bhavati | sthāṇurvā puruṣo vā iti | yadi śakunisamavāyaṃ paśyati veṇuvalayaṃ vā hariṇaṃ vā samīpe paśyati | tadā budhyate | ayaṃ sthāṇuriti | yadi calaṃ vastraṃ paśyati, yadi vākuñcanaṃ prasāraṇañca paśyati | tadā budhyate ayaṃ puruṣa iti | evaṃ buddhyahaṅkāramanaindriyāṇāṃ kramaśo vṛttiḥ | yathā cakṣurdarśanam‌ | tathā śrotrādīnīndriyāṇyapi kramikāni jñeyāni | dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaviṣayayostrayasya vṛttirindriyapūrviketi | dṛṣṭe dharme trayasyendriyāśrayā kramaśo vṛttiruktā | idānīmadṛṣṭe'pi dharme trayasyendriyāśrayā vṛttirvakṣyate | yathoktaṃ gāthāyām‌ | yugāvasānasamaye bhaviṣyati yathā janaḥ | kuduṣṭyācārato buddhadharmasaṃghāpavādakaḥ | vikariṣyati duṣṭaḥ san‌ pitṛjñātisuhṛjjanān‌ | catastro durgatīrgatvā nayiṣyati parāniha || yathānāgate tathātīte'pi śrotrendriyāśrayā kramaśo vṛttirdharmatrayasya | evaṃ trividhadharmo bāhyendriyapūrvakaḥ pravartate || 30 || para āha | trayodaśemāni karaṇāni acetanāni yadi puruṣeṇa īśvareṇa vā nādhiṣṭhitāni | kathaṃ pṛthak pṛthag‌ gṛhṇanti svaviṣayam‌ | āryayottaramāha | svāṃ svāṃ pratipadyante parasparākūtahetukāṃ vṛttim‌ | puruṣārtha eva heturna kenacitkāryate karaṇam‌ || 31 || trayodaśakamanyena vinā svāṃ vṛttiṃ kurta iti | śāstre'smin‌ īśvaraḥ puruṣaśca na kartetyuktaṃ prāk‌ | atastrayodaśa karaṇāni yathāsvaviṣayaṃ svayaṃ kurvanti nānyena | yathā kaścidbrāhmaṇo brahmacārī śṛṇoti kutracitpradeśe vedācāryo'dhyāpayati yatheṣṭamadhīyānām‌ | iti | [adhyavasyati] ahamavaśyaṃ tatra gatvā adhyeṣye iti | ayameva mahatkṛto'dhyavasāyaḥ | ahaṅkāro mahadākūtamupalabhya evaṃ manyate | sarve brāhmaṇā vidyamānānyupakaraṇāni saṃcinvate | ahaṃ sarvaṃ nītvā gamiṣyāmi tatra gatvā [mama] hṛdayaṃ mā śithilaṃ bhavatu | iti | mano'haṅkārākūtamupalabhyemaṃ saṃkalpaṃ karoti | prathamaṃ kaṃ vedamadhyeṣye | kiṃ sāmavedamadhyeṣye | kiṃ vā yajurvedam‌ iti | bāhyendriyāṇāṃ manassaṃkalpaparijñāne cakṣurmārgamavalokayati | śrotramanyavacanaṃ śṛṇoti | karaḥ kuṇḍikāṃ dhatte | pādaḥ panthānaṃ krāmati | iti pṛthak‌ pṛthak‌ [svāṃ] vṛttiṃ kurvanti | yathā corādhipaḥ ājñāṃ karoti | nirgamane praveśe dhāvane sthitau ca sarvatrāvaśyaṃ māṃ śṛṇudhvamiti | sarvo'yaṃ corasaṅgho'nusaratyājñām‌ | tathā imāni indriyāṇyapi | buddhiścorādhipopamā | avaśiṣṭānīndriyāṇi corasaṅghopamāni buddhyākūtajñānāt‌ pṛthak‌ pṛthak‌ svāṃ vṛttiṃ kurvanti | para āha | imāni trayodaśa karaṇāni prati prati purovartiviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti | kimidaṃ svārtham‌ | uta parārtham‌ | uttaramāha | puruṣārtha [eva] heturnānyena kāryate karaṇam‌ iti | ayamarthaḥ prāguktaḥ | puruṣārthasya kāryatvāt‌ guṇāḥ sṛjantīndriyāṇi [yāni] puruṣārthaṃ viṣayān‌ prakāśayanti āharanti dhārayanti ca | yadyucyate bhavatā imānīndriyāṇyacetanāni kathaṃ pravartante | ucyate | eṣāmindriyāṇāṃ nāstyanya īśvaraḥ [ya]stanmadhyamāgamyādhitiṣṭhettatpravṛtyupadeśāya | kevalaṃ puruṣaḥ prakṛtyā yujyamānaḥ pravṛttyutthāpanāyaivaṃ manyate mama kaivalyārthaṃ tvayā prakāśayitavyam‌ | iti | etatpuruṣārthahetostrayo guṇā indriyāṇi sṛjanti | [tāni ca] svasvavṛttiṃ puruṣārthavaśātkurvanti | ataḥ puruṣārthaṃ vinā nāstyanyaḥ vyatiriktaḥ pravartakaḥ || 31 || para āha | caturviṃśati[tattveṣu] kati nāma tattvāni karaṇāni | āryayottaramāha | karaṇaṃ trayodaśavidhaṃ tadāharaṇadhāraṇaprakāśakaram‌ | kāryañca tasya daśadhā''hāryaṃ dhāryaṃ prakāśyañca || 32 || karaṇasaṃkhyā trayodaśeti | asmin‌ śāstre tatra tatroktāni karaṇāni trayodaśaiva niyatāni | pañcajñānendriyāṇi pañcakarmendriyāṇi buddhyahaṅkāramanāṃsi iti | etāni trayodaśa kiṃ kāryaṃ kurvanti | āharaṇadhāraṇaprakāśakārāṇi | teṣāṃ kāryaṃ daśavidham‌ | śabdādayaḥ pañcaviṣayāḥ vacanādayaḥ pañcavṛttayaḥ, etāni daśa tatkāryāṇi | [kiñca] tatkāryaṃ trividham‌ | āhāryam‌ prakāśyam‌ dhāryamiti | tatra tribhirāhṛtaṃ pañcajñānakaraṇaiḥ prakāśitaṃ pañcakarmakaraṇāni dhārayanti ityetatkāryatrayasya hetostrayodaśendriyāṇi vyavasthāpitāni | ata uktamāhāryaṃ dhāryaṃ prakāśyamiti || 32 || para āha | katīndriyāṇi trikālaviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti | katīndriyāṇi vartamānaviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti | āryayottaramāha | antaḥkaraṇaṃ trividhaṃ daśadhā bāhyaṃ trayasya viṣayākhyam‌ | sāmpratakālaṃ bāhyaṃ trikālamābhyantaraṃ karaṇam‌ || 33 || antaḥkaraṇaṃ trividhamiti | buddhyahaṅkāramanāṃsi trividhāni | etāni antaḥkaraṇākhyāni | bāhyaviṣayāgrahaṇād‌ antarityākhyā sthāpitā | puruṣārthopāyasādhanasamarthatvātkaraṇamityucyate | daśabāhyakaraṇāni trayasya viṣayā iti | daśabāhyakaraṇāni pañcajñānendriyāṇi pañcakarmendriyāṇi bāhyaviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti | ato bāhyakaraṇamityākhyāyante | trayasya viṣayā iti | [trayasya] buddhyahaṅkāramanaindriyāṇām‌ | daśa karaṇāni tadviṣayā iṣyante | yathā rājā prajā niyojayati | tathaiva trīṇīndriyāṇi daśakaraṇāni kārayanti | bāhyaṃ karaṇaṃ sāmprataviṣayaṃ gṛhṇāti | imāni daśavidhendriyāṇi vartamānaviṣayagocarāṇi | kathaṃ jñāyate | śrotrendriyaṃ sāmpratakālameva śabdaṃ gṛhṇāti | [itara]kāladvaye'śravaṇāt‌ | yathā śrotrendriyam‌ | yāvad‌ ghrāṇendriyamapyevam‌ | vāgindriyaṃ vartamānanāmapadavyañjanāni bhāṣate | atītānāgatāni tu na bhāṣate | yathā vāgindriyam‌ | tathāvaśiṣṭāni catvāryapi | ābhyantaraṃ trikālaviṣayaṃ gṛhṇāti | iti | buddhyahaṅkāramanāṃsi trividhāni trikālaviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti | buddhiḥ sāmprataghaṭaśarāvādīn‌ gṛhṇāti | atītamapi gṛhṇāti | yathā purā māndhātā [nāma] rājā babhūva | anāgatamapi gṛhṇāti | yathā janānāṃ nāśo bhaviṣyatītyucyate | tathāhaṅkāro'pi trikālaviṣayān‌ madīyamiti manyate | evaṃ manaindriyamapi trikālaviṣayān‌ saṃkalpayati | anāgataṃ prārthayate | atītaṃ smarati ca | ata uktaṃ ābhyantaraṃ trikālaviṣayaṃ gṛhṇāti iti || 33 || para āha | katīndriyāṇi saviśeṣaṃ viṣayaṃ gṛhṇanti | katīndriyāṇi nirviśeṣaṃ viṣayaṃ gṛhṇanti | āryayottaramāha | buddhīndriyāṇi teṣāṃ pañca viśeṣāviśeṣaviṣayāṇi | vāgbhavati śabdaviṣayā śeṣāṇyapi pañcaviṣayāṇi || 34 || trayodaśamadhye buddhīndriyāṇi viśeṣāviśeṣaviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti iti | eṣāṃ trayodaśakaraṇānāṃ madhye pañcabuddhīndriyāṇi saviśeṣanirviśeṣaviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti | saviśeṣāstriguṇamayāḥ | nirviśeṣāḥ kevalaikaguṇāḥ | yathā svarge pañcaviṣayāḥ śabdasparśarūparasagandhākhyāḥ | ete pañcaviṣayā nirviśeṣāḥ | samasattvātmakatvāt‌ | ete pañcaviṣayā arajastamaskāḥ | manuṣyagatau pañcaviṣayāḥ saviśeṣāḥ sattvarajastamoyogasiddhāḥ | tasmāddevānāṃ buddhīndriyāṇi nirviśeṣaviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti | manuṣyāṇāṃ buddhīndriyāṇi tu sattvarajastamorūpaviśeṣavadviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti | tasmā[duktaṃ] buddhīndriyāṇi viśeṣāviśeṣaviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti | iti | vāk‌ śabdamātraviṣayeti | devavāk‌ manuṣyavāk‌ ca śabdamātraviṣayā nāmapadavyañjanāni bhāṣate | śeṣāṇāṃ caturṇāṃ pañcāpi viṣayā iti | pāṇīndriyaṃ pañcaviṣayātmakaṃ pañcā[tmaka]viṣayān‌ gṛhṇāti | tadyathā pāṇirghaṭaṃ gṛhṇāti | yathā pāṇiḥ, tathā śeṣāṇyapīndriyāṇi | evaṃ catvārīndriyāṇi pañcaviṣayasaṃsthānāni pañcā[tmaka]viṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti || 34 || athendriyāṇāṃ lakṣaṇāntaramāryayāha | sāntaḥkaraṇā buddhiḥ sarvaṃ viṣayamavagāhate yasmāt‌ | tasmāttrividhaṃ karaṇaṃ dvāri dvārāṇi śeṣāṇi || 35 || buddhiḥ sāntaḥkaraṇā sarvaṃ viṣayamavagāhate | iti | buddherahaṅkāreṇa manaindriyeṇa sadā yogād‌ uktaṃ buddhiḥ sāntaḥkaraṇeti | trilokān‌ viṣayān‌ trikālān‌ viṣayāṃścāvagāhate | ata uktaṃ sarvaṃ viṣayamavagāhata iti | tasmāttrividhaṃ karaṇaṃ dvāri | iti | buddhyādi trividhaṃ karaṇa[mātmānaṃ] dvārāṇāmadhipaṃ karoti | yadi buddhyādi trividhaṃ karaṇaṃ suyuktaṃ cakṣurindriye vartate | [tadā] taccakṣurindriyaṃ rūpaṃ prakāśayati na śeṣāṇīndriyāṇi | imāni trīṇi [karaṇāni] ekendriyasamavāyāt‌ trilokaviṣayān‌ trikāla[viṣayāṃ]ścāvagāhante | tasmāducyate imāni trīṇi [karaṇāni] daśakaraṇānyadhitiṣṭhanti iti | śeṣāṇi indriyāṇi sarvāṇi dvārāṇi iti | yaduta pañcajñānendriyāṇi pañcakarmendriyāṇi | tri[karaṇā]nusāritvād‌ vivṛtāni saṃvṛtāni vā bhavanti | yadi trikaṃ cakṣuṣi vartate | tadā cakṣurdvāraṃ vivṛtaṃ purovartiviṣayamavagāhate | śeṣāṇi dvārāṇi tu saṃvṛtāni viṣayaṃ nāvabuddhyante | anyānusāritvāt‌ kevalaṃ dvārāṇi na vastutaḥ karaṇāni | evaṃ daśendriyāṇi trividhakaraṇena saṃyuktāni sarvān‌ trilokaviṣayānavagāhante || 35 || kiñcāryāmāha | ete pradīpakalpāḥ parasparavilakṣaṇā guṇaviśeṣāḥ | kṛtsnaṃ puruṣasyārthaṃ prakāśya buddhau prayacchanti || 36 || karaṇāni pradīpakalpānīti | yaduta pañcajñānendriyāṇi pañcakarmendriyāṇi ahaṅkāro manaindriyañca | yathā pradīpa ekatrāvasthitaḥ padārthān‌ samaṃ prakāśayati | evaṃ karaṇāni trīlokaviṣayān‌ prakāśayati | ata uktaṃ pradīpakalpānīti | guṇamanusṛtya parasparavilakṣaṇānīti | parasparavidharmāṇi | śrotraṃ śabdaṃ gṛhṇāti na rūpam‌ | cakṣustu rūpaṃ gṛhṇāti na śabdam‌ | yāvannāsikā kevalaṃ gandhaṃ gṛhṇāti na rasam‌ | jñānendriyeṣu indriyaṃ prativiṣayaṃ niyataṃ vilakṣaṇañca | ata uktaṃ parasparavilakṣaṇānīti | karmendriyamapyevam‌ | vāk‌ kevalaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ vyavaharati | na śeṣāṃ vṛttiṃ karoti | yāvadbuddhiḥ kevalamadhyavasāyaṃ karoti | ahaṅkāraḥ kevalamabhimānaṃ karoti | manaḥ kevalaṃ saṃkalpaṃ karoti | ato'pyuktaṃ parasparavilakṣaṇānīti | tadvailakṣaṇyaṃ katham‌ | trīn guṇānanutsṛtyāhaṅkāro viṣamaḥ pravartate | ata ahaṅkāraḥ pañcatanmātrāṇi indriyāṇi ca sarvāṇi viṣamāṇi sṛjati | trilokaviṣayān‌ prakāśya puruṣārthaṃ buddhau prayacchantīti | imāni dvādaśendriyāṇī lokaviṣayān‌ prakāśya sarvān‌ buddhau prayacchanti | yathā rāṣṭre sarve'mātyajanā deśadhanāni saṃgṛhya rāṣṭrapālāya prayacchanti | evaṃ viṣayā dvādaśendriyairbuddhau pradīyante | ato buddhaḥ puruṣaṃ [viṣayān‌] pradarśayati | ata uktaṃ puruṣārthaṃ buddhau prayacchantīti || 36 || para āha | kasmādindriyāṇi viṣayān prakāśya na svayaṃ puruṣāya pradarśayanti | āryayottaramāha | sarvaṃ pratyupabhogaṃ yasmātpuruṣasya sādhayati buddhiḥ | saiva ca viśinaṣṭi tataḥ pradhānapuruṣāntaraṃ sūkṣmam‌ || 37 || puruṣasya sarvaṃ pratyupabhogaṃ yasmādbuddhiḥ sādhayati iti | puruṣasyopabhogaḥ sarvatra na samaḥ | yadi vā manuṣyagatau yadi vā devagatau yadi vā tiryaggatau daśaviṣayopabhogo yāvadaṣṭaiśvaryopabhogaṃ [na samaḥ] | jñānendriyakarmendriyadaśabāhyakaraṇāni imān‌ viṣayān‌ prakāśya buddhāvarpayanti | buddhiḥ puruṣe'rpayituṃ svīkaroti | tena puruṣa upabhogaṃ labhate | anena ca hetunā buddhiḥ kramaśaḥ puruṣaṃ yatheṣṭamupabhoktāramaiśvaryasukhasya lābhinaṃ ca karoti yāvatprajñā notpadyate | kiñca paścātkāle pradhānapuruṣayoḥ sūkṣmamantaraṃ darśayati | iti | paścātkālaḥ prājñaprādurbhāvakālaḥ | pradhānapuruṣau viviktāvitīmaṃ vivekamanabhyastācāyacaryā janā na paśyanti | ata uktaṃ sūkṣmamiti | sā ca viveke dvāramiti trayodaśake buddhireva puruṣaṃ darśayati | darśanaṃ kiṃlakṣaṇam‌ | yaduta pradhānapuruṣau bhinnau, trayo guṇā bhinnāḥ, buddhirbhinnā, ahaṅkāro bhinnaḥ, ekādaśendriyāṇi bhinnāni, pañcatanmātrāṇi bhinnāni, pañcamahābhūtāni bhinnāni śarīraṃ bhinnamiti darśanam‌ | evamādibhedabuddhiḥ puruṣasya jñānamutpādayati | tasmātpuruṣo mokṣaṃ labhate | yathoktaṃ prāk‌ | pañcaviṃśatitattvajño yatra tatrāśrame vaset‌ | jaṭī muṇḍī śikhī vāpi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || iti | tasmātkevalaṃ buddhirekā puruṣasya vastutaḥ karaṇam‌ || 37 || para āha | pūrvamāryāyāmuktamindriyāṇi viśeṣāviśeṣaviṣayān‌ gṛhṇanti iti | ke [te] viśeṣāviśeṣāḥ | āryayottaramāha | tanmātrāṇyaviśeṣāstebhyo bhūtāni pañca pañcabhyaḥ | ete smṛtā viśeṣāḥ śāntā ghorāśca mūḍhāśca || 38 || pañcatanmātrāṇyaviśeṣā iti | bhavānāha sma | ke viśeṣāviśeṣā iti | adhunā samādhāsyate | ahaṅkārādutpadyante pañcatanmātrāṇi sūkṣmāṇi śāntāni sattvalakṣaṇāni ca | etānyeva devānāṃ viṣayā aviśeṣāśca | devānāṃ śokamohābhāvāt‌ | tebhya utpannāni pañcamahābhūtāni | bhautikaviṣayāḥ saviśeṣā iti | śabdatanmātrādākāśamutpannam‌ | yāvad‌ gandhatanmātrātpṛthivī utpannā | imāni pañcabhūtāni saviśeṣāṇi | ime viśeṣāḥ kiṃlakṣaṇāḥ | śāntāḥ ghorāḥ mūḍhāśca | tāni pañcamahābhūtāni manuṣyaviṣayāḥ | ākāśamahābhūtasya kāni trīṇi lakṣaṇāni | yathā kaścinmahān‌ dhanikaḥ garbhagṛhamantaḥ praviśya pañcakāmasukhānyanubhuṅkte | kadācidunnataṃ prāsādamāruhya sudūramakāśamahābhūtaṃ paśyati | [tena] ākāśena sukhamanubhavatītyataḥ śāntam‌ | athavā unnate prāsāde niviṣṭaḥ ākāśaśītavātena spṛśyate | tadā ākāśaṃ duḥkhajanakam‌ | athavā punaḥ kaścin‌ mahatyadhvani caran‌ kevalamākāśaṃ paśyati | na grāmasamudāyaṃ paśyati | viśrāntisthānañca nāsti | tadā mohajanakam‌ | tathā śeṣāṇi mahābhūtānyapi | evaṃ devānāṃ pañcatanmātrāṇi viṣayā ekāntaśāntā ityaviśeṣāḥ | manuṣyā mahābhūtaviṣayāḥ | mahābhūtāni ca triguṇavanti | tasmātsaviśeṣāṇi || 38 || para āha | viśeṣā yathāvibhāgamuktāḥ | kimima eva viśeṣāḥ kiṃ vā punaranye viśeṣāḥ santi | samādhīyate | punaranye viśeṣāssanti | yathāhāryā | sūkṣmā mātāpitṛjāḥ saha prabhūtaistridhā viśeṣāḥ syuḥ | sūkṣmāsteṣāṃ niyatā mātāpitṛjā nivartante || 39 || sūkṣmā mātāpitṛjāḥ prabhūtā [iti] trividhā viśeṣā iti | sarvāṇi triṣu lokeṣu ādau sūkṣmaśarīrāṇi kevalatanmātrakānyutpannāni | tāni sūkṣmaśarīrāṇi garbhāśayaṃ praviśanti | śukraśoṇitasaṃyogaḥ sūkṣmaśarīraṃ vardhayati | ṣaḍvidhā annapānarasā āpyāyitāḥ sthūlaśarīrasyopacayaṃ vṛddhiñca puṣṇanti | mātuḥ putrasya cānnapānamārgai saṃyuktau | ataḥ [sthūlaśarīraṃ] poṣitaṃ vardhate | yathā vṛkṣo mūle jaladvārayuktatvād‌ āpyāyayan‌ vardhate | evamayamannapānarasaḥ tadgamanamārgeṇāntaḥ praviśya sthūlaśarīraṃ vardhayati | yādṛśaṃ sūkṣmaśarīrasya pramāṇaṃ, sthūlaśarīrasyāpi tādṛśam‌ | sūkṣmaśarīramābhyantaramucyate | sthūlaśarīraṃ bāhyamucyate | sūkṣmaśarīre'smin‌ pāṇipādaśiromukhodarapṛṣṭhaṃ manuṣyalakṣaṇaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhavati | yathā vadanti maharṣayaścaturvedeṣu | sthūlaśarīraṃ ṣaḍāśrayam‌ | raktamāṃsasnāyūni trividhā mātṛjāḥ | śukramajjasthīni trividhāḥ pitṛjāḥ | ete ṣaḍ‌ dehāśrayā [iti] | bāhyena sthūlaśarīreṇābhyantaraṃ sūkṣmaśarīraṃ vardhyate | asyābhyantarasūkṣmaśarīrasya sthūlaśarīreṇopacitasya garbhāśayānnirgamakāle nirgate ca bāhyapañcamahābhūtāni tadvihṛtisthānāni bhavanti | yathā rājaputrasya anye nānāprāsādakakṣaṃ gṛhaṃ kurvanti | idaṃ sthānaṃ viharaṇayogyaṃ, idaṃ sthānaṃ bhojanayogyaṃ, idaṃ sthānaṃ svāpayogyamiti | tathā pradhānamapi sūkṣmasthūlaśarīrayorāśrayasthānakaraṇāya pañcamahābhūtāni sṛjati | ākāśamahābhūtamavakāśane sṛjati | pṛthivīmahābhūtaṃ viharaṇe sṛjati | ab‌ mahābhūtaṃ śuddhau sṛjati | tejomahābhūtamāhārapacane sṛjati | vāyumahābhūtaṃ vyūhane sṛjati | evaṃ trividhā viśeṣāḥ sūkṣmāḥ mātāpitṛjāḥ śāntaghoramūḍhātmakaprabhūtāni | ime trayo'nye viśeṣā ucyante | para āha | eṣu triṣu viśeṣeṣu kati nityāḥ katyanityāḥ | uttaramāha | triṣu sūkṣmā niyatāḥ śeṣā nivartante | iti | eṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ madhye pañcatanmātrāṇi dṛṣṭāni | sūkṣmā viśeṣā ādyaśarīrajanakā niyatāśca | yadā sthūlaśarīraṃ nivartate, sūkṣmaśarīrañca yadyadharmayuktam‌ | tadā catvāri janmānyupādatte | catuṣpāt‌ pakṣī uragaḥ tiryag‌ iti | yadi dharmayuktam‌ | tadā catvāri janmānyupādatte | brahmā devaḥ prajāpatiḥ manuṣya iti | evaṃ sūkṣmaśarīraṃ tu niyataṃ sat‌ saṃsaratyaṣṭasu sthāneṣu | yāvat‌ jñānavairāgye notpanne staḥ | jñānavairāgye yadyutpanne | tadā etaccharīramukto mucyate | ata uktaṃ sūkṣmā viśeṣā nityā iti | śeṣāḥ sthūlaviśeṣā nivartamānā anityā ityucyante | maraṇakāle sūkṣmaśarīraṃ sthūlaśarīramutsṛjati | etat‌ sthūlaśarīraṃ mātāpitṛjātaṃ yadi vā pakṣibhiḥ khādyate yadi vā pūtikaṃ śīryate yadi vāgninā dahyate | mūḍhasya sūkṣmaśarīraṃ saṃsāre saṃsarati || 39 || para āha | bhavatoktaṃ mātāpitṛ[jaṃ] śarīraṃ nivartata iti | kiṃ punaṃ śarīraṃ saṃsarati saṃsāre | āryayottaramāha | pūrvotpannamasaktaṃ niyataṃ mahadādisūkṣmaparyantam‌ | saṃsarati nirupabhogaṃ bhāvairadhivāsitaṃ liṅgam‌ || 40 || pūrvotpannaṃ śarīramasaktamiti | purā pradhānaṃ pravartamānaṃ sat‌ lokamasṛjat‌ | sūkṣmaśarīraṃ prathamamajāyata | pradhānādbuddhirajāyata | buddherahaṅkāro'jāyata | ahaṅkārātpañcatanmātrāṇyajāyanta | etāni sapta sūkṣmaśarīramityucyate | sūkṣmaśarīralakṣaṇaṃ kīdṛśam‌ | brahmarūpasadṛśam‌ | viṣayānanubhūya paścādetaccharīraṃ mokṣamāpnoti | asaktamiti | yathoktamācāryaiḥ | etatsūkṣmaśarīraṃ tiryaṅmanuṣyadevagatiṣu sthitamapi, parvatapāṣāṇabhittyādinā na pratihantuṃ śakyate | sūkṣmatvāt‌ || iti | na ca vikriyate | yāvat‌ prajñā notpadyate [tāvat‌] sadā na viyujyate | idaṃ niyatamākhyāyate | mahadahaṅkārapañcatanmātrakamiti | etaccharīraṃ katibhistattvaiḥ siddhyati | saptavidhasūkṣmatattvaiḥ | ṣoḍaśavidhasthūlatattvaparyantaiḥ idaṃ śarīraṃ kiṃ karoti | saṃsarati, nirviṣayopabhogam‌ | tatsūkṣmaśarīramekādaśendriyasaṃyuktaṃ kadācit‌ caturṣu janmasu praviṣṭaṃ trīn‌ lokān‌ saṃsarati | nirviṣayopabhogamiti | yadyekādaśendriyāsaṃyuktam‌ | yadi mātāpitṛjātasthūlaśarīrarahitam‌ | [tadā] viṣayopabhogaśaktirnāsti | bhāvairadhivāsitaṃ liṅgamiti | sūkṣmaśarīrasya bhāvāḥ trividhāḥ | [taiḥ] bhāvairadhivāsitam‌ | ime trayo bhāvāḥ paścādvakṣyante | sāṃsiddhikabhāvaḥ prākṛtikabhāvaḥ vaikṛtabhāva iti bhāvāstrividhāḥ | ebhistribhirbhāvairadhivāsitaṃ sūkṣmaśarīram‌ | liṅgamiti | anāryairadṛṣṭatvāt‌ | tatsūkṣmaśarīraṃ saṃsarati saṃsāre || 40 para āha | ebhiḥ trayodaśendriyaiḥ saṃsāre saṃsaraṇāyālam‌ | kiṃ mithyāsūkṣmaśarīreṇa | āryayottaramāha | citraṃ yathāśrayamṛte sthāṇvādibhyo vinā yathā chāyā | tadvadvinā'viśeṣaistiṣṭhati na nirāśrayaṃ liṅgam‌ || 41 || yathā citraṃ bhittimṛte na, sthāṇvādibhyo vinā na chāyā iti | loke'smin‌ ādhārādheyau dvau dharmau saṃyuktau dṛṣṭau na viyuktau | yathā citrarūpaṃ bhittyāśrayam‌ | bhittiṃ vihāya pṛthaṅ‌ na tiṣṭhati | tasmātsūkṣmaśarīraṃ vihāya trayodaśakaṃ na sthātuṃ kṣamate | kiñca sthāṇuṃ vinā chāyā nirāśrayā | agnivirahe prakāśo nāsti | jalavirahe śaityaṃ nāsti | vāyuvirahe sparśo nāsti | ākāśaṃ vinā neryāpathaḥ siddhyati | evaṃ sūkṣmaśarīraṃ vinā sthūlaliṅgaṃ nirāśrayamuparamate na tiṣṭhati | tasmāduktaṃ pañcatanmātraśarīraviyuktañcet‌, trayodaśakaṃ nirāśrayaṃ tiṣṭhatīti || 41 || para āha | idaṃ sūkṣmaśarīraṃ trayodaśakena saha kimarthaṃ saṃsāre saṃsarati | āryayottaramāha | puruṣārthahetukamidaṃ nimittanaimittikaprasaṅgena | prakṛtervibhutvayogānnaṭavadvyavatiṣṭhate liṅgam‌ || 42 || puruṣārthahetukamiti | puruṣārthasya kartavyatvāt‌ pradhānaṃ vikriyate | [puruṣā]rtho dvividhaḥ | śabdādyupalabdhiviṣayaḥ guṇapuruṣāntaradarśanamantimaḥ | brahmapadādiṣu puruṣāḥ śabdādiviṣayaiḥ saṃyujyante | saṃyuktāḥ paścādvimucyante | ataḥ pradhānaṃ sūkṣmaśarīraṃ vikaroti | idaṃ sūkṣmaśarīraṃ kiṃnimittaṃ saṃsarati | nimittanaimittikahetoḥ | nimittaṃ yaduta dharmādīni aṣṭavidhāni paścādvakṣyante | āryāmevāha | dharmeṇa gamanamūrdhvaṃ gamanamadhastādbhavatyadharmeṇa | jñānena cāpavargo viparyayādiṣyate bandhaḥ || imāni nimittanaimittikāni punaḥ kiṃnimittaṃ siddhyanti | prakṛtervibhutvaśaktyanusārāditi | yathā [kaścit‌] rāṣṭrapālaḥ svarāṣṭre arthānusārāt‌ [kāryaṃ] karoti | tathā pradhānamapi devamanuṣyatiryagādisargaṃ karoti | ata uktaṃ naṭavatpravartate liṅgamiti | yathā naṭaḥ kadāciddevarūpo dṛśyate | kadācidrājarūpo dṛśyate | kadācinnāgapiśācādirūpo vicitro vibhinnaśca dṛśyate | sūkṣmaśarīramapyevaṃ trayodaśakena saṃyuktaṃ kadācidgajāśvādikukṣiṃ praviśya gajāśvādyātmanā pariṇamate | kadācinmanuṣyadevādikukṣiṃ praviśya manuṣyadevātmanā pariṇamate | ata uktaṃ prakṛtervibhutvaśaktyanusārānnaṭavatpravartate liṅgamiti || 42 || para āha | uktaṃ prāk‌ trividhairbhāvairadhaivāsitāni trayodaśendriyāṇi saṃsāre saṃsaranti | iti | ke [te] trividhā bhāvāḥ | āryayottaramāha | sāṃsiddhikāśca bhāvāḥ prākṛtikā vaikṛtāśca dharmādyāḥ | dṛṣṭāḥ karaṇāśrayiṇaḥ kāryāśrayiṇaśca kalalādyāḥ || 43 || sāṃsiddhikāḥ prākṛtikā vaikṛtā [iti] trayo bhāvā iti | sarvabhāvā bhāvākhyāstrividhāśca bhavanti | sāṃsiddhikāḥ prākṛtikāḥ vaikṛtā iti | sāṃsiddhikā yathā kapilamunerādau sahajāścatvāro guṇāḥ | dharma jñāna virāga aiśvaryāṇīti | ime caturvidhā guṇāḥ sāṃsiddhikāḥ | ataste catvāro gunāḥ sāṃsiddhikabhāvāśrayiṇaḥ | ke prākṛtikāḥ | prākṛtikā iti | yathoktaṃ vede | purā [kila] brahmaṇaścatvāraḥ putrāḥ samajāyanta | sanka sanandana sanātana sanatkumāranāmānaḥ | eṣāṃ caturṇāṃ putrāṇāṃ saṃpūrṇakaraṇakāryāṇāṃ śarīravatāṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣe catvāro bhāvā akasmātsiddhā dharmajñānavirāgaiśvaryākhyā akasmānnidhidarśanalābhavat‌ [iti] | ete catvāro bhāvā na nimittalabdhāḥ | ataḥ prākṛtikā ityucyante | vaikṛtā bhāvā iti | vikṛtirnāmācāryamūrtiḥ | ācāryamūrtinimittāt‌ śiṣyāḥ sagauravaṃ sabhaktiṃ copagamya śrutvā jñānaṃ labhante | jñānādvairāgyaṃ labhante | vairāgyāddharmaṃ labhante | dharmādaṣṭavidhamaiśvaryaṃ labhante | ime śiṣyaguṇāścatvāra ācāryamūrtilabdhatvādvaikṛtā ucyante | ebhiścaturbhirguṇairadhivāsitaṃ mahadādi antaḥkaraṇaṃ saṃsarati saṃsāre | ete catvāro guṇāḥ pratipakṣaiḥ saha aṣṭavidhāḥ | ime'ṣṭadharmāḥ kimāśritya vartante | uttaramāha | dṛṣṭā antaḥkaraṇāśrayiṇaḥ sūkṣmāśrayiṇaśca kalalādyā iti | antaḥkaraṇaṃ yanmahadādi | samahānaṣṭabhāvayuktaḥ | catvāro mahadāśrayiṇo vartante | yathoktaṃ prāk‌ | adhyavasāyo buddhirdharmo jñānaṃ virāga aiśvaryam‌ | sāttvikametadrūpaṃ tāmamasamasmādviparyastam‌ || iti | ime'ṣṭavidhā antaḥkaraṇāśrayiṇaḥ siddhāḥ | te'ṣṭabhāvāścāryajanairdivyacakṣuṣā dṛṣṭāḥ | ata uktaṃ dṛṣṭā iti | sūkṣmāśrayiṇaśca kalalādyā iti | yadaṣṭavidhaśarīrāṇi kalala budbuda peśī ghana[māṃsa] garbha kumāra yauvana sthāvirākhyāni | imānyaṣṭavidhāni caturbhirannarasairvṛddhiṃ labhante | mātṛnimittāḥ ṣaḍrasāścatvāri śarīrāṇi vardhayanti | kṣīrarasād‌ garbhaśarīraṃ vardhate | stanyapānāt‌ kaumāraśarīraṃ vardhate | avaśiṣṭāhāranimittora raso'ntime dve śarīre vardhayati | etadaṣṭavidhaṃ śarīraṃ sūkṣmaśarīramāśritya siddhyati | ime ṣoḍaśa padārthā antaḥkaraṇamadhivāsayanti | sūkṣmaśarīrañca saṃsarati saṃsāre || 43 || para āha | nimittanaimittikahetornaṭavatpravartate liṅgamiti prāguktam‌ | [tatra] kiṃ nimittaṃ kiṃ naimittikam‌ | uttaramāha | dharmeṇa gamanamūrdhvaṃ gamanamadhastādbhavatyadharmeṇa | jñānena cāpavargo viparyayādiṣyate bandhaḥ || 44 || loke yadi manuṣyo yamaniyamādi dharmaṃ karoti | tena dharmeṇa janmopādānakāle sūkṣmaśarīramūrdhvaṃ gatvā aṣṭasu sthāneṣu utpadyate | brāhmaṇam‌ prājāpatyam‌ aindram‌ gāndharvam‌ yākṣam‌ rākṣasam‌ yāmam‌ paiśācam ityaṣṭasthāneṣu janma labhate | yadi taddaśavidhadharmaviparītamadharmaṃ karoti | janmopādānakāle adho gatvā pañcasu sthāneṣu utpadyate | catuṣpāt‌ pataga uraga tiryak‌ sthāvareṣu pañcasu sthāneṣu adharmeṇotpadyate | jñānodvegābhyāmapavarga iti | sūkṣmaśarīreṇa jñānaṃ labhate jñānena vairāgyaṃ labhate | vairāgyeṇa sūkṣmaśarīraṃ tyajati | puruṣakaivalyādapavarga ityākhyāyate | tadviparyayaścettadā bandha iti | jñānaviparītamajñānam‌ | yathā puruṣo vadati ahaṃ anukampyaḥ ahaṃ priyaḥ mama priyamiti | ahaṅkārā[devaṃ] manyate ahamiti | idamucyate'jñānam‌ | idamajñānaṃ svaśarīraṃ badhnāti | tena manuṣyadevatiryakṣu vartate | bandhastrividhaḥ prakṛtibandhaḥ vikṛtibandhaḥ dakṣiṇābandha iti | ete trayaḥ praścādvakṣyante | ata uktaṃ nimittanaimittiketi | dharmo nimittamākhyāyate | ūrdhvagamanaṃ naimittikam‌ | adharmo nimittam‌ | adhogamanaṃ naimittikam‌ | jñānodvegau nimittam‌ | apavargo naimittikaḥ | ajñānodvegau nimittam‌ | bandho naimittikaḥ | [iti] catvāri nimittāni catvāri naimittikāni uktāni || 44 || kiñca catvāri nimittāni catvāri naimittikāni santi | [tānya]dhunā vakṣyati | vairāgyātprakṛtilayaḥ saṃsāro rājasādbhavati rāgāt‌ | aiśvaryādavighāto viparyayāttadviparyāsaḥ || 45 || vairāgyātprakṛtilaya iti | [yathā] kaścidbrāhmaṇaḥ pravrajito mārgamadhīyāna ekādaśendriyāṇi nigṛhṇāti | ekādaśaviṣayān‌ dūrataḥ pariharati | yamaniyamādidaśadharmān‌ saṃrakṣati | tadā udvegaṃ labhate | udvegādvairāgyam‌ | pañcaviṃśatitattvajñānaṃ tu nāsti | tasmānnāstyapavargaḥ | ayaṃ mriyamāṇaḥ kevalamaṣṭasu prakṛtiṣu līyate | aṣṭa prakṛtayo yaduta prakṛterbuddhirahaṅkāraḥ pañcatanmātrāṇi | aṣṭasu prakṛtiṣu sthitaḥ anavāptamokṣo mukta iti manyate | paścātsaṃsaraṇakāle triṣu lokeṣu sthūlaśarīraṃ punarutpādatte | ata uktaṃ vairāgyātprakṛtilaya iti | ayamucyate prakṛtibandha iti | rājasādrāgātsaṃsāra iti | rājaso rāga iti | yathā kaścinmanyate | ayaṃ mahādānamācarāmi, mahāyajñaṃ devakāryaṃ karomi, somarasaṃ pibāmi, paraloke sukhamanubhaviṣyāmi iti | anena rājasarāgeṇa brahmasthānāditiryagjātiparyante saṃsāre janmopādatte | ayamucyate dakṣiṇābandha iti | aiśvaryādavighāta iti | aiśvaryaṃ sattvajātīyamaṣṭāṅgamaṇimālaghimādi | anenaiśvaryeṇa brahmādisthānaṃ yatrāṣṭavidhāvighāto bhavati | imanayaṣṭaiśvaryāṇi buddhyā saṃyogād‌ vikṛtibandha ityucyante | tadviparyayādvighāto'sti iti | yadaiśvaryaviparītaṃ tadanaiśvaryam‌ | anaiśvaryeṇa sarvatra vighātaḥ | ayaṃ vighāto'pi vikṛtibandhaḥ | asya tāmasadharmatvāt‌ | ityasyāmāryāyāṃ catvāri nimittanaimittikānyuktāni | vairāgyaṃ nimittam‌ | prakṛtilayo naimittikaḥ | rājasarāgo nimittam‌ | saṃsāro naimittikaḥ | aiśvaryaṃ nimittam‌ | avighāto naimittikaḥ | anaiśvaryaṃ nimittam‌ | vighāto naimittikaḥ | evamaṣṭanimittāni aṣṭanaimittikāni itīme ṣoḍaśasargā uktāḥ || 45 || para āha | ime ṣoḍaśanimittanaimittakasargāḥ kimātmakāḥ | āryayottaramāha | eṣa pratyayasargo viparyayāśaktituṣṭisiddhyākhyāḥ | guṇavaiṣamyavimardena tasya bhedāstu pañcāśat‌ || 46 || sargo buddhinimittātmaka iti | sarga iti ṣoḍaśako vā aṣṭavidhāni naimittikāni vā | yadi ṣoḍaśavidhaḥ, [tadā] aṣṭa nimittāni aṣṭa naimittikāni ca buddhyātmakāni | aṣṭavidhāni vā [iti pakṣe] aṣṭa naimittikāni sargākhyāni | aṣṭa nimittāni tadātmakāni | ata uktaṃ ṣoḍaśavidhaḥ sargo buddhinimittātmaka iti | yathā prāgāryoktā | adhyavasāyo buddhirdharmo jñānaṃ virāga aiśvaryam‌ | sāttvikametadrūpaṃ tāmasamastmādviparyastam‌ || iti | viparyayāśaktituṣṭisiddhaya iti | te ṣoḍaśasargabhedāścaturdhā bhinnāḥ | viparyaya aśakti tuṣṭi siddhaya iti | yathā kaścidbrāhmaṇaścaturbhiḥ śiṣyaiḥ saha mahato rāṣṭrapālāt‌ svadhāma pratinivavṛte | pathi gacchan‌ sūrye'nudite tacchiṣyaḥ kaścittadāvocadācāryam‌ | ācārya mārgamadhye yatkiñcitvastu paśyāmi | na jāne ayaṃ sthāṇurvā puruṣo vā iti | [evaṃ] asya śiṣyasya sthāṇau saṃśayo'jāyata | ācāryo dvitīyaṃ śiṣyamavocat‌ | gatvā vimṛśya vilokaya puruṣo vā sthāṇurvā iti | ayamācāryavacanena tato dūrādeva vyalokayat‌ | na tatsamīpaṃ gantuṃ samartho'bhūt‌ | tadā
